Born Again Concerts proudly presents ALLIED IN CARNAGE TOUR XENTRIX XENTRIX were called SWEET VENGEANCE from 1984 to 1988. The original lineup consisted of vocalist/rhythm guitarist Chris Astley, guitarist Kristian Havard, bassist Paul MacKenzie, and drummer Dennis Gasser. The band attracted attention with a five-star rating from Kerrang! magazine, and Roadrunner_Records then contacted the band asking them why they had not been sent a copy and arranged an audition with the band. After the audition, the band were signed to the label and recorded their first album Shattered Existence in the summer of 1989. The band toured with SABBAT in support of the album. In a June 2019 interview with Metal Crypt, guitarist Havard revealed that XENTRIX had already begun writing the follow-up to Bury the Pain. By March 2021, the band had written and demoed at least twelve songs for their new album and announced that August they were in the studio recording it. The album was completed in June 2022, and a month later, the band announced Seven Words (album) as its album title and that it would be released on 11 November. Seven Words peaked at No. 39 on the UK Rock & Metal Albums Chart. In order to promote Seven Words, XENTRIX (along with WHIPLASH and ARTILLERY) supported Vio-lence on their European MTV Headbangers Ball Tour. Astley rejoined by filling in for Walsh on the tour as Walsh was awaiting the birth of his second child in November 2022. XENTRIX renewed their deal with Listenable Records…

ai.en: Ghibli classics: Spirited Away by candlelight is a concert at Kensington United Reformed Church, featuring the soundtrack to the Studio Ghibli film.

events.description: Lose yourself in the spellbinding world of Spirited Away as the cherished soundtrack of Hayao Miyazaki’s iconic Studio Ghibli anime is performed live by a chamber orchestra. The enigmatic world of Spirited Away, Hayao Miyazaki’s Oscar-winning masterpiece, is one of the most beloved works in the history of animation. First released in 2001, this Studio Ghibli classic follows the story of Chihiro, a young girl who finds herself in a mysterious spirit world, encountering unforgettable characters and learning courage, resilience, and compassion along the way. In the intimate surroundings of Kensington United Reformed Church, lit by a flicker of hundreds of candles, a small chamber orchestra will perform Joe Hisaishi’s iconic score — music that has become inseparable from the film’s magic. From the gentle wonder of One Summer’s Day to the wistful beauty of Reprise, each piece captures Miyazaki’s gift for blending the fantastical with the deeply human. Hayao Miyazaki, co-founder of Studio Ghibli, is celebrated worldwide for his hand-drawn storytelling, rich imagination, and timeless themes. His works — from My Neighbour Totoro to Howl’s Moving Castle — have touched generations, but Spirited Away stands as a defining achievement: a dreamlike tale of transformation, friendship, and the enduring power of hope. This is more than a concert — it’s a journey to a place where spirits whisper, trains glide across quiet waters, and memories linger in the air. This concert is part of a…

events.description: Parallel Lines Promotions Presents Genesis Owusu Plus Special Guests MAHA Over the past five years, Ghanaian-Australian artist Genesis Owusu has emerged as one of the most exciting artists of the moment. Back-to-back albums Smiling with No Teeth (2021) and Struggler (2023) were released to critical acclaim, cementing him as one of the most distinct and innovative artists to have risen from the Australian scene in recent years. Now, at 27, he readies himself to release his third album, REDSTAR WU & THE WORLDWIDE SCOURGE. An eclectic musical journey sits in the underscore of the album. A kaleidoscopic display of instrumentation and sound bending sees genre borders crumble into dust. The sound bed shifts with the turning tides of the record. Neo-Soul feeding into Alt Pop, Synth Punk into Funk. This delicate weaving guides listeners through moments of collective ecstasy and desolation, resistance and joy, dance and reflection. The ability to tune his blended taste into one, to carve the purest of human emotions into song, is a unique gift that Owusu has honed, the depth of feeling in the record effortlessly matching the depth of his lyricism. "I started writing this album because I was seeing so much of the world and watching what was happening," he says. "I feel like I had something important to say. ai.en: The Caribbean One Love Dinner and After-Party with Saxon Sound takes place at Boisdale, Canary Wharf. Saxon Sound started in Lewisham in 1976. DJs play from 8 pm to 2 am, and dinner reservations start at 5 pm.

events.description: Dinner & Table Reservations from 5pm. DJs from 8pm-2am Saxon Sound System started in Lewisham in 1976 and spent the next fifty years becoming one of the most significant forces in British music, which is not an overstatement. They pioneered the fast-chat MC style that gave birth to jungle, drum and bass, UK garage and grime. They launched Maxi Priest, Tippa Irie, Smiley Culture and Papa Levi. In 1988 they went to Jamaica and defeated opponents on their home turf, something no UK sound had done before. In 1992 they won the UK Cup Clash. In 1994 they became the first UK sound system to win the World Clash. Jazzie B credits them as a key influence on Soul II Soul. Massive Attack invited them to curate the 2008 Meltdown festival. Chuck D, KRS-One and Wycliffe Jean were all stopped in their tracks by Saxon cassette tapes. David Rodigan has been saluting them for decades. On Saturday nights at Boisdale, Musclehead, Sean M, Victor V and Sir Allan Brando bring that history to the first floor bar. The format is exactly what Saxon has always done best: the latest and the classic, mixed live with MCs on the mic and shout-outs bookable on the night for anyone celebrating. This is not a tribute to what Saxon used to be. It is Saxon, still doing it. events.description: WINTER METAL MELTDOWN TRIPLE-HEADER. GIRLSCHOOL are one of the most enduring names to emerge from the New Wave of British Heavy Metal. Formed in 1975, they became closely associated with MOTÖRHEAD and enjoyed major success in the early 1980s with their distinctive blend of punk-infused metal. Nearly five decades later, they remain the longest-running all-female rock band in the world, continuing to tour internationally and inspire generations of female musicians. Original members Kim McAuliffe and Denise Dufort remain at the heart of the band alongside new bassist Olivia Airey. RAVEN are true heavy metal pioneers. Formed in Newcastle in 1974 by brothers John and Mark Gallagher, the band helped shape the sound of speed and thrash metal through a string of hugely influential NWOBHM releases. Their impact on metal history is immense, with bands such as METALLICA and ANTHRAX citing them as key influences. Renowned for their relentless energy and uncompromising live shows, RAVEN continue to fly the flag for authentic heavy metal, now featuring Mike Heller on drums alongside the Gallagher brothers. ALCATRAZZ return with a powerhouse line-up featuring founding members Jimmy Waldo, virtuoso guitarist Joe Stump, seasoned vocalist Giles Lavery (Warlord, Jack Starr, Dragonsclaw) . Combining classic ALCATRAZZ material with newer soon to be classics, the band delivers a high-energy metal show backed by the momentum of their acclaimed recent album "Prior Convictions". events.description: Born Again Concerts proudly presents THE WAR THAT NEVER ENDS – WINTER 2026 1914 with support PHOBETOR Trench Warfare Meets Blackened Death-Doom: 1914 Unleash Their Fourth Onslaught of War-Torn Fury! Ukrainian blackened death/doom metal formation 1914 return with unrelenting force on their fourth studio album, Viribus Unitis, Latin for "With United Forces." Far more than a historical reference to the personal motto of Franz Joseph I of the Austro-Hungarian Empire, the title reflects the band’s resilience through war, loss, and upheaval – a powerful symbol of survival and solidarity. Releasing on November 14, 2025 via Napalm Records, Viribus Unitis builds on the band’s acclaimed conceptual approach, pushing even deeper into emotional and musical intensity. Continuing their chronicle of World War I, 1914 shift their focus slightly, from the raw portrayal of death and destruction to themes of camaraderie, endurance, and the emotional landscapes of those who endured the horrors. While previous releases like The Blind Leading the Blind (2018) and Where Fear and Weapons Meet (2021) centered on the futility and finality of war, Viribus Unitis explores the human bonds forged under fire and the strength of those who returned: broken, changed, yet still alive. Musically, 1914 remain true to their identity – brutal mixture of blackened death metal, slow-burning doom, and ambient war soundscapes. This time, however, their sound gains a broader dynamic range, with soaring melodic leads…

As My Darling Clementine they are known for their signature blend of classic country duets, richly drawn storytelling, and beautifully observed songs of love, loss and longing but this new date offers something different. They will play 2 x one hour sets; The first a deep dive into the back catalogue, featuring My Darling Clementine classics, fan favourites, and some lesser heard album cuts. The second set will shine a spotlight on their individual voices. With both releasing solo albums this year, Lou and Michael will present a number of these new songs, accompanied by a full band.* Michael's album "Nothing Can Hurt Me Anymore" released in April, has received 5 star universal praise, and is being widely regarded as his finest ever work. events.description: Doors 7:45 PM, Music 8:30 PM - 2 set(s) of music Line-up: Ant Law - Guitar Tom Farmer - Double bass Jon Scott - Drum kit Fabienne Ambuehl - Piano, Voice About: Fabienne Ambuehl is known for her vibrant contemporary jazz, weaving together elements of poetry and storytelling. Her latest album Thrive, released on Ubuntu Music, won ‘Jazz Recording of The Year’ at the 2025 Presto Music Awards. The music of the London-based, Swiss-born pianist, singer and composer receives widespread acclaim from the international jazz press. Ambuehl’s sound is lyrical and rich in detail, with fluid, expressive piano playing and emotive vocals, drawing inspiration from both the natural world and urban life. Her debut album Glitterwoods (Traumton, Berlin), was named ‘Album of the Year’ by UK Vibe and she has since worked with various artists internationally. Thrive was selected as ‘Album of the Week’ by Germany’s Rondo Magazine, and had regular radio play on Jazz FM UK and BBC Radio 3. Ambuehl was described as posing "somewhat of a triple threat as a fine pianist, wonderful singer and a composer of note” by Jazzviews UK. Together with acclaimed guitarist Ant Law, bassist Tom Farmer and drummer Jon Scott, the Fabienne Ambuehl Quartet creates a sound that is daring yet intimate, and truly its own. With compelling rhythms and melodies loosely influenced by blues, Brahms and the Beatles, you will hear songs from the album Thrive as well as brand new material from their upcoming next album. ‘…Ambuehl…

events.description: Bring in the festive season with some amazing Cuban music!! ai.en: John Butcher, Phil Durrant and Mark Wastell play Vortex Jazz Club. Doors open at 7:45 pm, and music starts at 8:30 pm, across two sets.

events.description: Doors 7:45 PM, Music 8:30 PM - 2 sets of music Line-up: Mark Wastell - Drums John Butcher - Saxophone Phil Durrant - Electric Mandolin About: A trio that re-weaves many strands. The three initially performed together as part of the Chris Burn Ensemble in the late 1990s. In 1984 Butcher and Durrant (on violin) began an influential trio with guitarist John Russell which performed for 15 years. On one occasion with Wastell (on cello) replacing Russell. Thereafter, Butcher and Durrant (switching to electronics) continued as a duo. Spanning the years either side of the millennium, Durrant and Wastell explored reductionism together in various combinations. Wastell has now moved to drums and cymbals, a set-up which includes various parts of John Stevens' (an inspiration for him) original Spontaneous Music Ensemble kit. And Butcher played for 2 years in the last version of Stevens' SME (with guitarist Roger Smith). "Their “virtuosity” consists essentially and miraculously in constantly renewing their sonic resources almost infinitely. At once refined and abundant, like a journey in space, crossing stars and galaxies. Quite unique of its kind." (Orynx - Jean-Michel Van Schouwburg) ".... one of the wonders of this area of music, at least to these ears, the essential character of the music has cohered into something palpable and breathing. Butcher generates some lovely, slightly fluttering, ultra-soft tones on tenor, Wastell contributes spacious, irregular brush caresses of drum heads…

title.en: Ciyaal Fish & Chips : Somali Independence Day Special – London

ai.en: Ciyaal Fish and Chips: Somali Independence Day Special is a comedy show at Top Secret Comedy Club marking Somali Independence Day, celebrated on 1 July.

events.description: Somali Independence Day, celebrated on 1 July, marks the historic moment in 1960 when the former British and Italian-administered Somali territories came together to form the independent Somali Republic. It remains an important celebration of Somali history, culture and national identity. Celebrate Somali Independence Day with CIYAAL FISH & CHIPS – a special edition of the comedy night showcasing some of the funniest Somali voices on the UK comedy circuit. Featuring a full Somali line-up of comedians, the show is performed in English and is open to everyone. Acts: Diesel (Comedy Central Live, The Stand Up Sketch Show, Wise Fools) Bamph (Wise Fools, Urban Storyteller with a Punchy Edge) Prince Abdi (Comedy Central, ITV) Mo Ali (A Fresh Voice in Comedy) Expect a night of sharp stand-up, big personalities, hilarious stories and observations about family, relationships, work, growing up in Britain, cultural misunderstandings and everyday life. This special show brings everyone together to mark Somali Independence Day with a night of comedy, culture and celebration. The comedians may share a Somali background, but the laughs are universal. You don’t need to be Somali, speak Somali or know anything about Somali culture to enjoy the show. CIYAAL FISH & CHIPS is about bringing people together for a great night of live comedy. Whether you come with friends, family, colleagues or on your own, expect a welcoming atmosphere, a brilliant line-up and plenty of laughs as we celebrate…

events.description: Doors 6.30pm | Performance 8pm | Event Calendar CLICK HERE Performing Live - 5th Novemeber Global Soul x Rotation Collective x ILUVLIVE Monthly Residency - VERUSHKA An artist, producer and DJ based in South London whose music collapses earthy, moving soundscapes into jazz-tinged, soulful compositions. Her self-written and arranged 2022 album Not Even Bliss received support from BBC London, 6 Music and Jazz FM. The album launch sold out and Verushka went on to play various live shows, including Supreme Standards and We Out Here Festival. With support from Jazz FM, OneJazz and Twisted Soul, she released Holding On in September 2025, a track co-written with Chris Booth, featuring Yves Fernandez on bass and David Mrakpor on drums and keys. With a full-length music video, Verushka explores that weird in-between space many of us experienced during lockdown. Summer 2026 brought the release of her first ever self-produced EP, Don’t Wanna Be Here I Just Wanna Be There, followed by a single chosen by Somewhere Soul for his Rituals compilation, which came out on Mr Bongo in November. PEACH. Blending soul, R&B, jazz and hip-hop influences with honest songwriting exploring identity, self-expression and empowerment. Since emerging in 2023 with debut EP “Bops.”, they have earned support from Marshall and placements on Spotify’s Jazz UK, Fresh Finds and New Music Friday playlists. Latest single “Only Human” introduces the next chapter of an artist whose music champions authenticity…

ai.en: The Family Silver, a British power trio, play 229 with very special guests, presented by AGMP Concerts.

events.description: AGMP Presents THE FAMILY SILVER + very special guests The Family Silver are a British power trio bringing together three musicians with formidable pedigrees: singer/guitarist Matt Deighton (Mother Earth, Paul Weller, Oasis), bassist Damon Minchella (Ocean Colour Scene, Richard Ashcroft) and drummer Steve White (The Style Council, Paul Weller). Their music draws on classic British rock, soul, psychedelia and pastoral folk, underpinned by the instinctive musicianship of three players who had already spent decades at the heart of UK music. Their debut album, Electric Blend, appeared in 2015, followed by the limited Blaze of Light EP in 2017. A cult favourite rather than a heavily toured project, The Family Silver are enjoying renewed attention in 2026 with an expanded, newly mastered edition of Electric Blend, including rare and previously unreleased recordings. For acid-jazz fans, the connection is particularly appealing: Matt Deighton fronted Mother Earth, while White and Minchella's backgrounds encompass mod, soul, funk and jazz as well as some of the biggest names in British rock. The result is a genuine musicians' band - soulful, melodic and steeped in the sound of classic British songwriting. An AGMP Concerts presentation. events.description: UNOW Presents Boombox - Drone Tour '26 Boombox Drone Tour Across Europe. November-December 2026. Maxi-single "Alive" Release. Every time the Boombox management faces the task of writing a press release, we start recalling interesting facts. How many concerts we played, how much money we raised, which songs we released. That's the basics. It’s also good to remember whether the band has been to the country we’re heading to or if it’s the first visit. Oh, how we wish we could write: "Boombox Concert" — and like in Lviv, 8,000 tickets sold in a day. Yes, yes, we’re not talking about Lviv here, although it’s also about Europe. Our devoted listeners, if you are abroad, we hope you’ll be interested to know that after a traditional break of a few months, Boombox will go on tour from Israel to Germany, from England to Poland, from Ireland to Slovakia and the Czech Republic. And we’ll be taking along on this tour our fresh-as-a-Kherson-watermelon maxi-single "Alive," enhanced with songs from various albums, under some of which you grew up, and under others your children are growing up. So check it out, please pay close attention to the tour schedule, buy your tickets in advance, get your money ready for donations and merch — we’ll see you in November. Boombox, Dronotour 2026

Swiftly their uproarious and engaging style, coupled with keenly contemporary songs, gained a passionate national following, leading to a 40 year career filled with much loved music, a dedicated fan community and high octane performances. Touring continually throughout their career, TMTCH have crossed the globe by way of Europe, Canada, USA, Iceland, Egypt and Estonia. They have appeared at festivals such as Glastonbury, Roskilde, Reading, Pink Pop and Cambridge Folk and have appeared with a roll call of International artists such as David Bowie, Van Morrison, Bo Diddley, The Smiths, Elvis Costello and the Oyster Band to name a few. Their recordings have been acclaimed in print, on radio and online; from their definitive version of the anti war classic Green Fields of France to the anti fascist anthem Ghosts of Cable Street and the epic historical ballads, Ironmasters and The Colours. Recent albums The Defiant (2014) and Cockahoop (2018) have seen TMTCH rise again into prominence; their vitality undimmed. 2026 Devastated by the passing of friend and founder member Stefan Cush during the…

British star Adam Azim faces the biggest test of his career when he takes on Mexico?s Gabriel Gollaz Valenzuela in an IBF World Super Lightweight Title Eliminator on December 4, at the Copper Box Arena in London. The 24-year-old is on the brink of his first world title opportunity after a blistering third-round stoppage of Steve Claggett in May. Valenzuela, 32, from Guadalajara, has fought former world champion Subriel Matías and lost a controversial split decision to Lindolfo Delgado in another IBF eliminator. He has also won on British soil, beating Azim?s former stablemate Robbie Davies Jr in London in 2021 to claim the IBF International title. On the undercard, Francesca Hennessy faces France?s unbeaten Johanna Wonyou for the WBC Interim World Bantamweight Title. Unbeaten welterweights Elliot Whale and Bobby Faulkner meet for the WBA Continental title. Olympic bronze medallist Frazer Clarke returns, and unbeaten Hassan Azim, Adam?s older brother, takes on undefeated Ruben Torres.

events.description: Giant - The WoodentopsA Rock and Roll band with an anti name, not designed for commercial success achieved main stream radio, main stream chart positions, alternative respect, fan love from bright sparks like David Bowie and made one of the continually mentioned best loved albums of 1986, a peak year in in the history of UK music history.Its is the voices and words, the easy fall in of the beats and bass lines, the distinct guitar and the fun at the heart of the thing. It is both serious and good humoured, original but not without hinted influences, all part of the colour and vibrancy that makes the energy encapsulated here on tape, infectious and memorable.Giant included in its song list a strong list of club floor turntable hits, Give it time, Travelling man, Get it on, Everyday Living or the monster hit Why Why Why,. Remixes you would hear in Ibiza, Paris, New York, Milan, Los Angeles or London . The first single, Good Thing was one of those songs you would hear at anytime of the day on radio, taxicab, superstore, launderette or your own kitchen. It was the sound of that summer and still John Peel championed a supporter till the end.So after a few shots at performing the whole album live, hearing entire audiences spontaneously singing chorus’s ,fixing the magic and relearning the original arrangements, much altered through time, The Woodentops will devote much of 2016 to performing this milestone album as complete and original running order on its 30 year anniversary.

title.en: Rebecca Ferguson: The Hits at Christmas
Sounds of the Universe by candlelight: Zimmer, Richter, Einaudi

events.description: ✨ А unique concert will take place on December 4th at the 19th-century church in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. Step into a spellbinding neoclassical programme that leads audiences on a luminous journey through emotion and awe. Featuring the visionary works of Hans Zimmer, Ludovico Einaudi, and Max Richter, this concert blends cinematic grandeur, minimalist clarity, and haunting melodic nuance. Zimmer’s expansive compositions, like "Cornfield Chase" from Interstellar, conjure the vastness of space, while Einaudi’s delicate piano-driven pieces, such as "Petrichor", invite quiet reflection. Richter’s poignant "Sofa Chess" and the ethereal "Infra 4" interlace timeless restraint with contemporary texture. Together, these composers shape a sonic cosmos — where orchestral detail meets atmospheric depth, offering listeners a chance to dwell in the infinite sounds of the universe. Hans Zimmer, the constant collaborator in his films and one of the greatest film composers of our time, is an Oscar winner, a two-time Golden Globe winner, and a three-time Grammy winner. Zimmer’s original compositions will be reimagined for a unique ensemble of instruments, combining electronics and acoustic instruments. Ludovico Einaudi is, without a doubt, one of the most prominent representatives of neoclassicism. But success and recognition were not easy for him. From childhood, the weight of the achievements of his family members dominated the Italian. Ludovico’s mother played the…

The day-time clubbing event started by Vicky McClure, Jonny Owen and Reverend & The Makers has swept the UK since it’s launch in 2024 ‘The day-time disco that doesn’t ruin your Sunday’ has amassed a huge following with thousands of punters packing out clubs and theatres every weekend to dance the day away from. A whole generation who perhaps thought their clubbing days were behind them are blazing a trail for a new way to enjoy themselves. Day Fever prides itself on creating a safe-space where people can just be themselves. No dress code, no egos, just enjoyment and positivity. This has seen a loyal fanbase leading to sold out shows in some of the countries most famous venues. The music policy is simple, the greatest hits of the 20th century. Why can’t Madonna sit next to Madness? Pulp go back to back with Prince? The Stone Roses and The Rolling Stones? 90’s dance classics versus a spot of Motown? Why choose when you can enjoy it all? Vicky McClure says ‘Travelling up and down the country and seeing so many people enjoying themselves has been such a joy, we’re just so happy that people feel comfortable at Day Fever and meeting and hearing everyone’s stories has made us realise how important it is for us all to take some time out of life and just have a bloody good dance!’ Follow DAY FEVER on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X - @DAYFEVERUK OVER 18S ONLY/ID REQ, NO BAGS BIGGER THAN A4 SIZE

ai.en: Bruce Juice plays New Cross Inn, presented by Safe As Milk Promotions and New Cross Live.

events.description: Safe As Milk Promotions and New Cross Live present Bruce Juice A live injection of Bruce Juice during the long years between Bruce Springsteen’s tours, this new band provides a vibrant tonic pumped into every aching hungry heart. You can expect an ‘E-Street’ experience that captures the unique seven-piece band line-up through arrangements from legendary concerts such as the Main Point to the Bottom Line, Passaic, Winterland and Tempe. The band reproduces the original arrangements from the 1970s Wild, Innocent and a slow, bluesy ‘E Street Shuffle’ as well as the iconic anthems from the ‘Born to Run’ tour. More gems from the 1980s capture the crisp, rasping sound of the ‘Professor’s’ piano, Federici’s organ and Clarence’s sax from ‘The River’ tour, as well as a few stadium foot-stompers from the ‘Born in the USA’ tour. Bruce Juice stands out as there are usually couple of surprise gems thrown in, with some great Bruce songs that don’t normally feature in tributes, but are much loved by Bruce fans. This is the only Springsteen tribute band that combines both popular favourites with the essence of Springsteen’s arrangements in legendary live gigs and an unforgettable show. The term ‘tribute band’ doesn’t really fit – it is just that there isn’t another word. We are not trying to pay tribute to Bruce as if he has won an award or passed away. Instead, we absolutely LOVE his music and everything about the energy and passion with which he and the E Street Band deliver unforgettable…

title.en: Christmas Classics by Tim Burton. Mystery ensemble

events.description: ✨ Welcome to the fantastical worlds of Tim Burton! We invite you to celebrate this Halloween weekend on a journey through the music that made it unforgettable. А unique concert will take place in the atmospheric Kensington United Reformed Church, located in the heart of the royal borough of Kensington and Chelsea! From the shimmering wonder of Alice in Wonderland to the festive magic of The Nightmare Before Christmas, from the haunting lyricism of Edward Scissorhands to the eccentric brilliance of Charlie and the Chocolate Factory — this concert immerses you in the soundscapes that shaped Burton’s unique cinematic universe. At the heart of it all is the music of Danny Elfman, Burton’s lifelong collaborator and one of the most distinctive film composers of our time. Elfman’s music blends playfulness with menace, tenderness with grandeur — a perfect mirror of Burton’s visual imagination. Alongside Elfman, highlights include unforgettable moments from Corpse Bride, the cult favourite Beetlejuice, the gothic sweep of Batman, and the razor-sharp drama of Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street. In this premiere, Mystery Ensemble brings Burton’s worlds to life in unique arrangements. Expect soaring voices, bold instrumental colours, and an atmosphere that shifts in an instant — from the macabre to the magical, from the intimate to the epic. The concert's mysterious magic will arise from the connection between the musicians, flickers of hundreds of candles and the…

Please get in touch prior to making a booking by emailing support@hackney.church About Hackney Church Located in the heart of East London, Hackney Church, officially known as St John at Hackney, is the historic parish church of Hackney, dating back to 1792. Today, the church is part of SAINT, a thriving church meeting across multiple East London locations. Following a multi-million-pound restoration, part-funded by the National Lottery Heritage Fund, the church has undergone a substantial transformation, driven by a vision to create a 'cathedral of creativity' to serve the local community and beyond. This project was spearheaded by an acclaimed team including world-renowned minimalist architect John Pawson CBE, visual artist Es Devlin, and conservation experts Thomas Ford & Partners. The renovation not only improved the church’s accessibility but also meticulously preserved its historical integrity, establishing it as an impressive centre for community engagement. Hackney Church functions as a premier venue for live music, arts and culture, intertwined with Hackney's cultural and social landscape. About Lighthouse Lighthouse is the dedicated…

Robson was a seminal part of the London scene for over 2 decades before moving to New York City for 5 years. He is now based in Ireland. The trio play mostly Robson originals which are steeped in the swing, groove and the organ trio tradition, while also being contemporary with strong melodies making their music exciting but accessible to all who love to see passionate live music and real bands. title.en: The Music of Harry Potter by Mystery Ensemble

events.description: ✨ The world of magical music from the famous novels of the same name by J.K. Rowling! The evening programme includes music from unforgettable fantasy films of Harry Potter performed by the extraordinary Mystery Ensemble. The film's soundtracks were masterfully composed by John Williams. The composer wrote the music at his mansions in Los Angeles and Tanglewood and then recorded at Abbey Road and Air Lyndhurst studios in London in September 2001. The film features many characteristic leitmotifs, most of which were repeated in the second part of the Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets franchise. The main composition, "Hedwig's Theme", is present in all films in a modified form. The soundtrack was released on October 30, 2001, on CD media. On December 14, 2001, the soundtrack was certified gold in Canada (50,000 units) and in January 2002 in Japan (100,000 units). In 2002, John Williams was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Music for a Film but lost to Howard Shore, who wrote the compositions for another fantasy film, The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring, another fantasy film, “The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring”, music from which can also be heard at our concerts. The album became a success, peaking at number 48 on the Billboard 200 and number two on the Top Soundtracks Chart. In the official UK charts, the album was at number 19. events.description: Action! Presents ELUVEITIE ÀNV RISING – EUROPE Pt. III Plus Special Guests PAIN WOLFHEART Eluveitie, formed in 2002 by Chrigel Glanzmann, has consistently merged modern metal with Celtic musical traditions. Originating from the Swiss Alps and deeply rooted in Celtic history, mythology, and spirituality, the band has become a cornerstone of the modern metal scene. Their debut, "Vên" (2004), set the stage for a unique blend of melodic death metal and traditional folk. Subsequent albums like "Slania," "Everything Remains (As It Never Was)," "Helvetios," and "Origins" solidified their reputation. The acoustic albums "Evocation I – The Arcane Dominion" and "Evocation II – Pantheon" showcased their versatility. In 2022, Eluveitie released the singles "Aidus" and "Exile of the Gods," marking a new chapter in their musical journey and thematical cycle pursuing the lyrical concept opened by their last studio album "Ategnatos". These tracks were followed by the announcement of their upcoming album, "ÀNV," set for release in April 2025. The first single from this album, "Premonition," has just been unveiled, offering a glimpse into the band's evolving sound. Over the years, Eluveitie has undergone lineup changes, including their latest addition with Lea-Sophie Fischer on violin in May 2024. Despite these changes, the band's essence and soul remains untouched. With nine studio albums, numerous tours all around the globe, and headline shows worldwide, Eluveitie continues to be a dynamic…

ai.en: Adam Grant: The Secret to Successful Connections is a talk at Troxy about the science of friendship, companionship and love, based on his book.

events.description: "A deep dive into the science of friendship, companionship, and love. The world needs this book now more than ever" - Reese Witherspoon Adam Grant has changed the way millions of people think about work, success and human behaviour. Through his bestselling books, including Think Again and Hidden Potential, his ideas have transformed how leaders make decisions, how organisations build cultures, and how individuals unlock their potential. His TED Talks have been viewed more than 35 million times. His podcasts have surpassed 100 million downloads. And as a professor of organisational psychology at Wharton, he has become one of the world's most influential public thinkers. In his groundbreaking new book Vibe, Grant explores how the technology that has created an unprecedented level of connectivity is increasingly driving us apart. He reveals how we can forge faster, stronger, and longer bonds and explores how our assumptions have led us astray. Tim Harford hosts.

events.description: Grammy Award-winning artist Bilal returns to the spotlight to celebrate the 25th anniversary of one of neo-soul’s most influential albums — his debut, 1st Born Second. A singular voice in modern soul, Bilal blends jazz, funk, hip-hop and RnB with a vocal style that shifts effortlessly from raw intensity to soaring falsetto, cementing his place as one of the most respected artists of his generation. Released in 2001, the record helped redefine the boundaries of neo-soul, brought to life by the Soulquarians collective alongside collaborators including J Dilla, Dr. Dre and Mos Def. Revisiting the album in full — including timeless cuts like ‘Soul Sista’ and ‘Fast Lane’ — this is a rare chance to experience a classic reimagined live by one of soul music’s most distinctive voices.

Die Band verbindet die Energie des Metal mit dem Drama und der Intensität eines Horrorstrei- fens und erschafft so eine intensive und fesselnde Realität. Mit Songs, die Geschichten von Zombies, Überlebenskampf und dem unstillbaren Hunger nach immer Mehr erzählen, erwecken sie ihre untoten Charakte- re zum Leben und sorgen für ein Live-Erlebnis, das lebendiger nicht sein könnte. Frankenstein war gestern. —- And just when you thought it couldn't get any worse, it always can. The living dead are ready to emerge. Emerging seemingly out of nowhere, they give us a taste of what we all fear: a redefinition of what it means to be alive. But to be honest, with DOMINUM, that new life has already begun. DREZ CAMINO + MISSLOULOU + support from WESRI TICKETS £10(+1) ADVANCE / £12 ON THE DOOR Drez Camino: A London artist of Filipino heritage, Drez Camino crafts indie-soul soundscapes rooted in deep reflection yet raw in execution. With influences spanning genres and borders, his sound is both versatile and consistently vibrant, driven by a strikingly rich vocal tone. Raised in Reading, just a thirty-minute train from London, Drez's childhood orbited an indie-rock culture that defined his identity yet denied his image. Never having seen an Asian artist command the scene he loved, Drez Camino has never had the choice of imitation. Now, as he starts his own path, he faces nothing but an open space to make his own. MISSLOULOU: MISSLOULOU is a London-based alternative soul artist blending classic jazz vocal textures with electronic sounds and contemporary storytelling. With her striking vocal tone and lyrical honesty, she is positioning herself as one of the UK’s most exciting emerging voices. Wesri: Wesri is a Leicester-born singer/songwriter who blends acoustic guitars with soulful, indie textures to tell stories about what it feels like to be a young person in Britain navigating love, social pressure, and self-discovery. Influenced by storytellers such as Santan Dave, Khalid, and Tracey Chapman, his music pairs emotive lyricism with warm, atmospheric production, sliding fluidly between indie folk, soul, and bedroom pop. As he continues to refine his craft…

events.description: New Cross Live presents Mik Artistik's Ego Trip are genuinely delightful, funny, frightening, and indefinable. Northern rock and roll stand-up comes close. Mik fixes the audience with his compelling stare, hypnotising and charming them with stories, songs, and poems. Every show is unique as Mik finds a new train of thought to ride. He connects, chats, breaks the wall between audience and band, creates chaos, plays air-crook lock (!?), all complimented by exquisite layers of rock, soul, funk, and punk created by Jonny Flockton on electric guitar, drum machine, and one of a number of well-heeled bass players. The band are regular Glastonbury favourites since their first appearance in 2007. Many fans don't consider Glastonbury has started until they've attended either Mik’s gig on the Wednesday afternoon at the Croissant Neuf Bandstand, or the chaos that reigns at Thursday evening’s Rocket Lounge gig. Both are now Glastonbury traditions for many fans. They have achieved an enviable reputation at many of the major UK festivals, including Latitude, Bearded Theory, Beat Herder, Wilderness, and Beautiful Days. BBC Radio 6Music have long been playing Mik’s music with Gideon Coe, Chris Hawkins, Shaun Keaveny and Tom Robinson all big fans of the band. In early 2020 no-less than rock icon and 6Music presenter Iggy Pop endorsed Mik’s anthem of hope ‘Sweet Leaf of the North’ as his favourite song of the last DECADE! ... Formed in London and first making their mark on the capital’s live circuit in the late ’90s, The Replicant Saints bring back their distinctive mix of rootsy rock, big guitars and infectious live energy to the legendary Troubadour. This will be their 18th gig at the Troubadour - a venue that has welcomed an extraordinary roll call of musicians over the years, from Bob Dylan, Paul Simon and Jimi Hendrix to Adele and Florence Welch. Charlie Watts played there in 1961, while Led Zeppelin were known to return there for late-night jams after their Earl’s Court shows. It remains one of London’s great music rooms. Expect songs from the Saints’ past, a few surprises and the unmistakable sound of a band delighted to be back in the room together. Joining them are special guests The Moshed Haves and Martha Jane. events.description: Doors 7:45 PM, Music 8:30 PM - 2 sets of music Line-up: Mindaugas Stumbras - Guitar Mattia Galeotti - Drums Michelangelo Scandroglio - Double bass Fergus McCreadie - Piano About: Pan-European contemporary jazz quartet Being Human are a band built across borders. Bringing together acclaimed Lithuanian guitarist Mindaugas Stumbras, Mercury Prize-nominated Scottish pianist Fergus McCreadie, and a celebrated Tuscan rhythm section complete with Michelangelo Scandroglio (LVDF) and Mattia Galeotti, the group are united by a musical language that reaches beyond geography – folding the folk traditions of their respective homes into lyrical contemporary jazz, vivid melodic storytelling and free-flowing improvisation. Nine years in the making, their story is rooted first and foremost in friendship. Scandroglio, Galeotti and Stumbras first crossed paths at the Siena Jazz Summer Workshop in Italy, before Stumbras invited fellow Royal Conservatoire of Scotland student McCreadie into the fold. A formative Italian tour followed, setting in motion an unlikely musical relationship between four musicians living across four different countries. Through the logistical challenges of distance and the disruption of the pandemic, that connection has endured, developing across years of touring into a distinctive collective voice. Releasing on Friday 6th November via Bridge The Gap, the group’s new album ‘Minar of Dreams’ is the clearest articulation of that voice yet. Following their self-titled 2021…

ai.en: Ten Fé plays The George Tavern. The band began when songwriters Ben Moorhouse and Leo Duncan first played together at a house party in London.

events.description: Ten Fé began with a meeting at a house party in London, where songwriters Ben Moorhouse and Leo Duncan first played together. Between busking trips on the London Underground and songs written in each other’s bedrooms, they developed the partnership that would become Ten Fé. Old friend and bassist Rob Shipley joined a little later, becoming a driving force in the band alongside them. More than a decade later, they’ve released three albums, passed 100 million Spotify streams and built an international cult following. Leo grew up in the Black Country in an Irish household steeped in folk singing. Ben came from East London, finding his way through Britpop and psychedelia before studying jazz at the Royal Academy of Music. They shared a love of older songs and an instinct for making music that connected with people straight away. Those different backgrounds have given Ten Fé room to move, with two distinct voices and approaches to songwriting finding common ground.

Matt Carmichael Heralded by BBC Music Magazine as "a distinctive new voice in a crowded scene," Scottish saxophonist and composer Matt Carmichael continues to move from strength to strength and grow his reach globally with his powerfully emotive blend of melodic jazz and folk music. Born just outside of Inverness before moving to Glasgow, where, at the age of 11, he enthusiastically ran home from school clutching a letter from his local music service offering saxophone lessons. Music instantly became his passion, and he soon began writing music for his own band, performing their first gig at the Butterfly and Pig in Glasgow — before half the band were legally allowed in the pub. Since then, the band has developed a special chemistry and sound together, grounded in collective improvisation. They regularly perform internationally at venues like Bimhuis, Fasching, Celtic Connections, Ronnie Scott’s, and Love Supreme, as well as Matt working as a soloist and arranger with the Grammy Award-winning WDR Big Band and the Scottish National Jazz Orchestra. events.description: Cara Dillon — Upon A Winter’s Night: A Christmas Tradition Rooted in Wonder Over the past decade, Upon A Winter’s Night has become much more than a Christmas tour. For many audiences, it has become part of Christmas itself, a much-loved annual tradition and a return, year after year, to music that offers space for reflection, wonder and connection. Now, in its tenth anniversary year, Cara Dillon brings this celebrated show to Union Chapel once more: an evening of darkness and light, and the mystery at the heart of Christmas. Released in 2016, and entering at number one on the Indie Album Charts, Upon A Winter’s Night quickly established itself as a distinctive and atmospheric way into Christmas. Drawing on Celtic hymns, ancient carols, traditional folk songs and original material, it reaches beyond the familiar sounds of the season towards something older, deeper and far more enduring. There is a particular stillness at the heart of these songs: the darkness of winter, the promise of light, the joy of birth and renewal. Woven together with Dillon’s unmistakable voice and the moving musicality of her band, they create an evening that is both intimate and expansive. For Dillon, that spiritual dimension remains central. Her relationship with this repertoire is deeply felt, and her voice brings an extraordinary clarity to music in which the sacred and the earthly have always existed side by side. It’s this combination that has made Upon A Winter’s Night such an essential part of…

title.en: A Ceremony of Carols by Benjamin Britten, John Tavener and Arvo Pärt

events.description: Red Events presents a radiant Christmas programme centred on Benjamin Britten’s A Ceremony of Carols in the magnificent candlelit setting of St. Gabriel’s church, Pimlico. Written in 1942 during Britten’s sea voyage from the United States to England and premiered the following year, this celebrated cycle of 12 short movements for voices and harp combines medieval English and Latin texts with music of remarkable clarity, delicacy and brilliance. By turns mystical, playful and radiant, A Ceremony of Carols has become one of the most beloved choral works of the Christmas season. Britten’s masterpiece is complemented by sacred works by John Tavener and Arvo Pärt, composers whose music explores the profound connection between spirituality, silence and sound. Performed by Ensemble Sinfonietta Bern together with singers from Creator Classics, a Vienna-based opera collective, the programme brings these meditative works into dialogue with Britten’s luminous choral writing. Additional seasonal works complete this atmospheric musical journey, inviting audiences to experience the wonder, serenity and joy of the season through some of the most luminous and moving sacred music of the twentieth and twenty-first centuries. The concert is organised by RED EVENTS & Distribution Ltd., an international cultural events producer known for creating distinctive experiences in atmospheric and architecturally remarkable settings, from churches, cathedrals and historic mansions to rooftops…

events.description: One of the UK’s most revered soul singers, Mica Paris has helped define British soul for decades. From gospel roots in her grandparents’ church to a Top 10 debut with 'My One Temptation' at just 18, she has collaborated with jazz luminaries like Courtney Pine, US soul singer Will Downing, and icons including Prince and Jools Holland—her voice marked by remarkable range, power, and unmistakable soul. Recently honoured with an MBE for her services to music, Mica returns to the stage with a full live band for two intimate shows, celebrating a career that continues to shine at the heart of UK RnB and soul. Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. CLICK HERE to see a detailed seat map of the restaurant. This event is strictly 18+ with ID required on arrival at the venue.

Leak has been described by Marcus O’Dair (The Wire) as ‘one of the best pianists of his generation …astonishing,’ and between them the musicians have performed with musicians including Jordan Rakei, Derrick May, Dan Tepfer, and Robert Mitchell.

events.description: Doors 7.30pm | Performance 8pm | Event Calendar CLICK HERE Rocksteady Reggae with Wayne Hernandez Expect a live set that honours the pivotal sounds of reggae, rocksteady, ska and lovers rock, featuring tracks by pioneers like Desmond Dekker, Alton Ellis and The Techniques. From Jimmy Cliff’s “Wonderful World, Beautiful People” and The Melodians’ “Rivers of Babylon” to Bob Marley’s “Don’t Rock My Boat” and John Holt’s beloved “Help Me Make It Through the Night”, each song captures a moment in Jamaican musical history. You’ll also hear lovers rock anthems and roots classics like “Tempted to Touch”, “Wild World” and “Money In My Pocket”, played live with the groove and energy they were born to carry. Rocksteady, which flourished in the mid-60s as a slower, more soulful evolution of ska, laid the foundations for reggae’s global rise and remains one of Jamaica’s most influential genres. ai.en: The Score Revisited marks the 30th anniversary of The Fugees album The Score. A full live band plays the album at Jazz Cafe.

events.description: A full live band performs The Fugees’ classic The Score in full to celebrate its 30th Anniversary. Blending classic doo-wop, soul, RnB and reggae into a contemporary framework, The Score became a pivotal force in the evolution of a new wave of hip-hop and neo-soul. Released in 1996, the album marked a defining moment for the trio of Lauryn Hill, Wyclef Jean and Pras Michel, who formed in the late 1980s in South Orange, New Jersey. From ‘Ready or Not,’ ‘Zealots,’ and ‘Fu-Gee-La,’ to ‘Family Business,’ and ‘Killing Me Softly With His Song’, this is a celebration of an album that changed the course of modern music. Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. CLICK HERE to see a detailed seat map of the restaurant. This event is strictly 18+ with ID required on arrival at the venue.

Doors 7:45 PM, Music 8:30 PM - 2 sets of music Line-up: Jonny Mansfield - Vibraphone Freddie Jensen - Double bass Luke Mccarthy - Drum kit Miles Mindlin - guitar About: Miles Mindlin is an award-winning virtuoso jazz guitarist, composer and bandleader based in New York City. Born in London, he settled in the city after completing his master’s at the Manhattan School of Music on a scholarship. He is in demand across the US, the UK and Europe, and has performed his own music at venues including the Royal Albert Hall, Ronnie Scott’s and The Vortex in London; Dizzy’s Club at Lincoln Center, Ornithology Jazz Club, NYC Closeup and The Owl in New York; and the Copenhagen, Aarhus and Hague jazz festivals. He has worked with leading artists including Dayna Stephens, Mark Shim, Alexandra Ridout, Alex Hitchcock, Felix Moseholm, Jamie Cullum, Noah Stoneman, Akili Bradley and Joey Curreri. His debut album, released on Fresh Sound in November 2023, features all original compositions that draw on literature, film and music in equal measure. On January 23, 2026, he recorded his second album, By Water, with an all-star band featuring his mentor Dayna Stephens, a leading figure in modern jazz, alongside Jonas Esser and Simón Willson, two of the most in-demand musicians on the New York scene. The album presents original compositions written over the past two years while living and working in New York, and will be released on Contagious Music in January 2027.

events.description: Doors 7:45 PM, Music 8:30 PM - 2 sets of music Line-up: Tony Kofi - Saxophone Simon Fernsby - Guitar Pete Whittaker - Organ Pete Cater - Drum kit About: Returning to his first instrument, the Alto Saxophone, Tony Kofi joins the Organisation for a celebration of alto saxophone legend Lou Donaldson, whose roots in Bebop evolved into a mastery of the Soul Jazz movement instigated by the great Jimmy Smith and championed by Blue Note founder Alfred Lion. Playing Lou Donaldson’s compositions and focusing largely on his work with the Hammond Organ mavericks like Dr Lonnie Smith,Charles Earland and Big John Patton. They will be playing tunes such as "Hotdog", "Blues Walk," “Good Gracious, Rev. Moses “Alligator Bogaloo” Turtle Walk and "Ode to Billy Jo" as well as associated compositions by Jimmy Smith, Pat Martino, George Benson and others. Gerry McAvoy celebrate the music of Rory Gallagher + special guests: BLUES 'N' TROUBLE DJ SNOWBOY The January Blues Festival celebrates it's 10th anniversary year with the welcome return of Band of Friends with original Rory Gallagher bassist Gerry McAvoy and friends performing the music of Rory Gallagher along with special guest support Blues 'n' Trouble. Irish Blues-Rock guitarist, songwriter Rory Gallagher started out in R&B power trio Taste in 1966. Taste supported Cream and Blind Faith before splitting in 1970 after their appearance at the Isle of Wight Festival. Rory Gallagher starting touring under his own name alongside bassist Gerry McAvoy to huge success before Rory's untimely passing in 1995. Inspired by Canned Heat and the Paul Butterfield Blues Band and named after the 60's Doctor Ross blues tune, BLUES 'N' TROUBLE were formed in the early 1980s by Tim Elliott (harmonica/vocals) and John Bruce (guitar). After the their acclaimed debut LP 'First Trouble' (1985), BLUES 'N' TROUBLE went on to become one of the hardest working blues bands on the scene. They shared stages with B.B. King, Robert Cray, Junior Wells, Buddy Guy, Pinetop Perkins, Charlie Musselwhite and recorded with Lazy Lester. Blues in Britain "Irresistibly evokes the West Side sound" Soul Bag Mag (France) The eldest son of the immortal Muddy Waters, Mud has followed in his beloved dad's mammoth footsteps, staunchly keeping the traditional Chicago blues flame alight by faithfully singing Muddy's songs as well as plenty of his own originals in front of an all-star band of Chicago's heavy-hitters. Everything in Mud's musical life traces directly back to his father. "I was born in the blues, man. I used to have to tap music on the side of my head before I went to sleep. I've had music running through my being all my life, since I've been here." Mud didn't emerge musically until the 2000s when veteran blues chanteuse Mary Lane gave him some of his earliest showcases on the West Side. His debut album was released in 2008. A three-time Blues Music Award nominee, his 2014 Severn Records release in collaboration with harmonica ace Kim Wilson, 'For Pops-A Tribute to Muddy Waters,' earned him the coveted award. events.description: AGMP Presents JANUARY BLUES FESTIVAL 2027 presents ERIC BIBB + special guests: Jo Harman The January Blues Festival celebrates it's 10th anniversary year with the welcome return of bluesman Eric Bibb. With a career spanning five decades, over forty albums, three Grammy nominations, a multitude of Blues Foundation awards and countless more accolades, Eric Bibb has secured his legacy as a legendary figure in the blues and roots genre. Born into a lineage of activism, Eric's father, the late Leon Bibb, was a key figure in the civil rights movement, marching alongside Dr. Martin Luther King. Immersed in the Village folk scene during his youth, Eric Bibb found inspiration in the visits of luminaries like Bob Dylan, Joan Baez, and Pete Seeger. Influenced deeply by the sounds of Odetta, Richie Havens, and Taj Mahal, he synthesized these elements into a style uniquely his own. Beyond conventional genres, Eric Bibb is labeled a bluesman, but he defies categorization, seamlessly sliding between musical realms. Grounded in the folk and blues tradition with contemporary sensibilities, Bibb's music reflects his thoughts on current world events and his own lived experiences, whilst remaining entertaining, uplifting, inspirational and relevant. Bibb's catalogue is now over 40 albums strong. His 2024 album In The Real World, recorded at Peter Gabriel's Real World Studios received critical acclaim. Eric Bibb is more than a blues troubadour; he is a storyteller and philosopher. His legacy is…

For more than six decades, Charlie Musselwhite has remained one of blues music's most respected voices - a harmonica virtuoso whose career has always been rooted in authenticity. Charlie Musselwhite didn't just witness the golden era of blues; he was baptized in it, cutting his teeth alongside icons like Muddy Waters and Howlin' Wolf, playing in the smoky clubs of Chicago's South Side where the music roared and history was written. The stage became his home, and fifty relentless years of touring shaped him into a master storyteller, his harmonica singing tales of joy, sorrow, and everything in between. With 20+ albums under his belt, a Grammy in hand, and more than 33 Blues Music Awards lining his path, Charlie Musselwhite's voice and musicianship continue to deepen-like the roots of the music he so passionately embodies. The blues may be timeless, but Charlie Musselwhite is the man who keeps it breathing, one note at a time. Kirk Fletcher plugs in his guitar and lets out the weight of the world. AGMP Presents The Ordinary Boys formed in Brighton, England, in the early 2000s. Drawing inspiration from seminal artists including The Jam, The Specials, Madness, The Smiths and Blur, the band developed a distinctive sound that fused angular indie rock, 2 Tone ska, punk attitude and classic British pop songwriting. Fronted by Samuel Preston, The Ordinary Boys earned acclaim for their sharp social commentary, infectious hooks and energetic live performances, bringing together the melodic immediacy of Britpop with the rhythmic drive of ska and the urgency of punk. The band's debut album, Over the Counter Culture (2004), introduced their unique blend of indie and ska influences, followed by the critically acclaimed Brassbound (2005), which expanded their sound with brass arrangements and socially conscious songwriting while producing fan favourites such as "Boys Will Be Boys." Their third studio album, How to Get Everything You Ever Wanted in Ten Easy Steps (2006), showcased a more polished and adventurous approach, incorporating elements of pop, electronic music and new wave without losing the band's unmistakable identity. Although the group experienced lineup changes and periods of hiatus, The Ordinary Boys have continued to reunite for live performances, with their catalogue remaining a touchstone of mid-2000s British indie. This self-contained process led to his 2018 breakout song “Heaven’s Only Wishful,” a stunningly singular ballad that stopped the world in its tracks and brought him personal praise from both Max Martin’s MXM Music and Steven Malkmus. His debut album Semblance, written and recorded during the pandemic lockdowns, followed in 2022. For his new era, however, collaboration is key. “Working alone sucks,” he says with a laugh, shaking his head at how things used to be. “It’s torturous and isolating.” The days of detachment in this new era and in their place is a feeling of letting go and allowing others in. Celeste, the Brit and Mercury Prize nominee, appears on the brand new single “Like Heaven.” Her voice sits perfectly alongside Nyquist’s cut-glass tenor, arriving like an intoxicating cloud of smoke and pushing a song about finding hope in faithless times to truly ascend. Celeste’s involvement was unplanned. “She came to [Rick Rubin’s Malibu studio] Shangri-La simply to hang out, but ended up jumping on the mix,” he says. “Her vocalwas recorded in that first session and it remains in the final version. She captured a raw, immediate energy that couldn’t be recreated.” MorMor headlines the ICA this January.

events.description: January Blues Festival presents P.P. ARNOLD + special guests P.P. Arnold is affectionately known as London's First Lady of Soul. Born Patricia Ann Cole in Los Angeles, California, she grew up singing gospel before joining Ike & Tina Turner's Ikettes in the mid-1960s. Arriving in Britain in 1966, she attracted the attention of Mick Jagger, who helped secure her a recording contract with Andrew Loog Oldham's Immediate Records. Her acclaimed albums The First Lady of Immediate (1967) and Kafunta (1968) established her as a major figure in the Swinging Sixties, producing timeless classics including The First Cut Is the Deepest, (If You Think You're) Groovy and Angel of the Morning, now favourites among mod, soul and Northern Soul enthusiasts. During the late 1960s and 1970s, Arnold became closely associated with the Small Faces, contributing memorable backing vocals to Tin Soldier and Itchycoo Park, while collaborating with artists including Rod Stewart, Eric Clapton, Barry Gibb, Humble Pie and Nick Drake. Her extraordinary career continued through the following decades, with notable appearances on Peter Gabriel's Sledgehammer, The Beatmasters' 1988 dance hit Burn It Up, and recordings by The KLF, Primal Scream and Ocean Colour Scene. In later years, P.P. Arnold enjoyed a remarkable resurgence, collaborating with Dr. Robert of The Blow Monkeys on the 2007 album Five in the Afternoon and releasing The Turning Tide (2017), a collection of previously unreleased recordings produced…

ai.en: Fujiya and Miyagi, the Brighton kosmiche pop band, play Moth Club.

events.description: Fujiya & Miyagi know when something is worth waiting for. The Brighton kosmiche pop outfit’s catalogue is strewn with surprises and creative about-turns, but incoming album ‘New Shiny Object’ could be their most dazzling yet. Crafted over a relentless four-year period of feverish south coast recording sessions, it’s a potent, succinct reminder of their art-pop skills, and the prevailing power of honesty in their work. Set to be released through their own Impossible Objects of Desire imprint on the 30th October, ‘New Shiny Object’ is an album which has been through multiple iterations over its four-year recording span, only to emerge with the truth. An ode to the transfixing, magical properties art can have, it’s consciously the work of older musicians – or as singer David Best puts it, “people who’ve lived a life.” The new record also marks 26 years of Fujiya & Miyagi and 20 years since their breakthrough album 'Transparent Things' became a global hit. This saw the band tour the world for the first time and gain notoriety of a different kind through a Jaguar car advert featuring the slinky rhythms of 'Collarbone'. Follow up 'Lightbulbs' (2008) led to a synch in 'Breaking Bad' with the hip-shaking funk of 'Uh', securing their place in many new fans’ hearts - and in the Spotify playlist foreverland.

events.description: AGMP Presents AGMP Concerts presents: THE FABULOUS THUNDERBIRDS + NINE BELOW ZERO (Acoustic) For over 30 years, The Fabulous Thunderbirds have been the quintessential American Blues band. The group's distinctive and powerful sound manifested itself into a unique musical hybrid via such barnburners as 'Tuff Enuff' and 'Wrap It Up'. Co-founder Kim Wilson, the sole original member, still spearheads the group. Muddy Waters called Kim Wilson his favorite harmonica player and vocalist. "Muddy Waters was very good to me," Wilson says. "He almost adopted me. I'll never forget him." Kim Wilson was influenced by Little Walter, George "Harmonica" Smith, Lazy Lester and James Cotton, Bobby "Blue" Bland, B.B. King, Otis Rush, Jimmy Rodgers, and Muddy Waters. Jimmie Vaughan & Kim Wilson founded the Fabulous Thunderbirds in 1974. In 1979, The Fabulous Thunderbirds released their first self-titled album. Primarily blues influenced, it became a cult classic. In subsequent releases, the band started to incorporate more Cajun, rock 'n roll and soul influences. The album 'T-Bird Rhythm' was produced by Nick Lowe. In 1986, The Fabulous Thunderbirds reached a commercial peak with the album, 'Tuff Enuff'. The single of the same title as well as the singles 'Wrap It Up' and 'Look At That', all went top 40. Kim Wilson - lead vocals, harmonica Johnny Moeller - guitar Bob Welsh - piano / guitar Rudy Albin - drums Steve Kirsty - bass An AGMP Concerts presentation.

events.description: Old Empire and Born Again Concerts proudly present GILES COREY with special guests TBA Giles Corey is the folk-driven solo work of Dan Barrett, co-founder of Have a Nice Life andEnemies List Home Recordings. This November he tours it entirely alone for the first time.First released in 2011, the self-titled Giles Corey album began with a simple constraint:acoustic instruments only. That boundary opened into something much larger—guitar, piano,ghostly choirs, heavy organ, field recordings, and sudden walls of sound arranged around anintimate singer-songwriter core.The songs move through depression, death, history, and the paranormal without treating anyof them as distant ideas. Quiet desperation gives way to cathartic outburst; privateconfession becomes communal release. The album and its accompanying book have sincegathered a fervent following, often described by listeners in the language of ritual or religiousexperience. These are the first Giles Corey dates since a handful of shows in 2023, and the first Barretthas ever performed entirely solo: stark voice and acoustic instruments, unstable electronics,and arrangements built to move from a whisper to physical impact. The set includes brandnew material performed live for the first time.

events.description: AGMP Presents A celebration of FANIA RECORDS + special guests Musica Latina Orchestra celebrate the legendary latin music label performing songs from through it's 60+ year back catalogue recorded by Fania All Stars, Celia Cruz, Rubén Blades, Ray Barretto, Héctor Lavoe, Willie Colón, Johnny Pacheco, Tito Puente and more. Fania Records was founded in 1964 by Dominican musician Johnny Pacheco and his Italian-American lawyer (and Cuban music fan) Jerry Masucci. It would become the greatest Latin music label of all time and the driving force behind the spread of salsa music from New York City to the rest of the world. Pacheco and Masucci would take the salsa gospel across the globe with the release of the 1971 award winning documentary "Our Latin Thing" and world tours by the label's in-house band the Fania All Stars. events.description: Tina Dico is a Danish singer-songwriter known for her distinctive voice, sharply observed lyrics and a catalogue spanning more than two decades. Since her debut in the early 2000s, she has released fourteen albums and built a devoted audience at home and internationally, balancing intimate songwriting with a ambitious musical scope. Over the years, Tina Dico has moved between solo records, full-band releases and collaborations, earning a reputation for deeply personal songs that explore love, family, longing, resilience and the contradictions of everyday life. Whether performing solo or with a band, her concerts are known for their warmth, honesty and close connection with audiences. In autumn 2026, Tina Dico releases a new studio album. After a period with releases in Danish, this will be her first release in English in 8 years. Based between Denmark and Iceland, Tina Dico continues to write, record and tour while remaining one of the most distinctive voices in Scandinavian songwriting.

ai.en: Lost Society and Hokka play Downstairs at The Dome. Lost Society are a Finnish metal band from Jyväskylä, formed in 2010.

events.description: LOST SOCIETY are a Finnish Metal band from Jyväskylä, formed in 2010. The lineup consists of guitarist/vocalist Samy Elbanna, guitarist Arttu Lesonen, bassist Mirko Lehtinen, and drummer Taz Fagerström. On their first two albums, Fast Loud Death (2013) and Terror Hungry (2014), they delivered fast and raw Thrash Metal with aggressive and party-themed lyrics often revolving around alcohol consumption. Their style started to change in their third album, Braindead (2016). While Braindead is still considered a Thrash Metal album, the band started incorporating elements of Groove Metal and Metalcore in their music and most of the lyrics started to shift to other topics rather than partying and binge drinking. This trend became more evident on their fourth album, No Absolution (2020), in which the band completely moved away from Thrash Metal. No Absolution can be classified as a blend of Metalcore, Death Metal, Groove Metal and Nu Metal. The lyrics on No Absolution focus on religion and its negative influence on people and society. Their fifth album If The Sky Came Down (2022) has shown the fans a more modern musical style. If the Sky Came Down is, similarly to No Absolution, a Metalcore album mixed with Nu Metal and Groove Metal. The lyrics on their fifth album have angsty and existential dread themes. This stylistic direction would continue further on their next album Hell Is a State of Mind (2026), which also saw the band incorporate symphonic elements.

ai.en: The Herbaliser Band plays Jazz Cafe. The band blends jazz, hip-hop and electronic music, and has been active for three decades.

events.description: Where jazz meets hip-hop and electronic, The Herbaliser have been setting the blueprint for three decades. Formed in London in the early ’90s by Jake Wherry and Ollie Teeba, The Herbaliser emerged from the UK’s burgeoning instrumental hip-hop scene and became closely associated with the influential Ninja Tune label. Their distinctive sound blends hard-hitting beats and turntablism with jazz, funk, soul and cinematic influences. From Blow Your Headphones and Very Mercenary to Take London and Bring Out the Sound, their extensive catalogue spans more than 30 years. Alongside their studio work, The Herbaliser have grown into a substantial live band, bringing their sample-heavy productions to the stage with horns, bass, drums, keyboards and turntables. title.en: Seun Kuti & Egypt 80 - Na Dem Tour

events.description: Gotobeat Presents Seun Kuti & Egypt 80 - Na Dem Tour Tuesday 23rd February 2027 Electric Brixton, London Seun Kuti is a Nigerian musician, singer, and songwriter renowned for his captivating performances and socially conscious music. He is the youngest son of Afrobeat pioneer Fela Kuti. Seun has spent most of his life preserving and extending his father’s political and musical legacy as the leader of his father’s former band Egypt 80. As a developing saxophonist and percussionist, he entered the formal ranks of the band before he was 12. In 1997 when Fela passed, in fulfilment of his father’s wishes, Seun assumed the mantle as head of Egypt 80 and he has run it ever since. As a musician and pan-African activist, Seun has been involved in a number of campaigns in recent years, including #OccupyNigeria and #EndSARS – a social movement against police brutality in Nigeria. Significantly, he’s revived the Movement of the People (M.O.P.), the political party his father set up in 1979, which was quashed by the military government not long after Fela’s failed presidential bid. NA DEM (Django Music), the new six-track album by Seun Kuti & Egypt 80, was released on November 6, 2026 across all digital platforms. With this bold new record, fully produced by Femi Koleoso (Ezra Collective), Seun Kuti pushes the boundaries of contemporary Afrobeat. The album features the track “Na Dem” (feat. Tom Morello) and “Problems” (feat. Kabaka Pyramid).

title.en: Illa J's Tribute to J Dilla

events.description: J Dilla's music, celebrated and performed by the brother who grew up alongside it. Dilla changed how hip-hop feels, with drums that swing just behind the beat, his sound sitting beneath records by The Pharcyde, Erykah Badu and D'Angelo. Donuts, released three days before his death in 2006, is still one of hip-hop's most loved instrumental albums, and his influence runs through a generation of producers who came after him. His younger brother, born John Yancey, debuted as Illa J in 2008 with Yancey Boys, rapping and singing over beats Dilla made for him, and went on to join Slum Village, the group Dilla cofounded. Illa J knows this music from the inside, and his set moves through Dilla's own records and the tracks his brother produced for him, alongside some new material of his own. We're donating £1 from every ticket sold to the J Dilla family estate. Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. CLICK HERE to see a detailed seat map of the restaurant. ai.en: Dog Unit play the ICA. The four-piece band's music is built on feeling rather than words.

events.description: Dog Unit’s language exists beyond words; it’s not in the telling, but in the feeling. The four friends take on the scale of a mutant orchestra, a single mind of 16 limbs in perpetual forward motion and unspoken shared purpose. A motorik groove, an insistent hook, a melody’s shifting breeze – these aren’t rock songs, but living, breathing creatures as prone to change and constancy as we are. Since their inception in 2019, Dog Unit have written with the intention to make an entirely instrumental record sing. The intricacies of their sound, the formidable sense of tension and relief, take on a new gravitas when seen live. The mythology of this band – boiler-suited, arranged in a horseshoe formation and building worlds in a hypnotic, unbroken hour of music – only underlines their miraculous synergy. Sam Walton and Henry Scowcroft’s guitars take a pendulum-swing from wild, wailing feedback to melodic grace; bassist James Weaver constructs sleek, minimal wonders with supreme focus; and the beats of drummer Lucy Jamieson grounds these forces and carves their path forward. 2024 saw the deliverance of Dog Unit’s vision with their debut album, At Home. It was written not as individual pieces but as a suite of music that follows an arc of storytelling. There is the soft-bleed of ‘Concrete Barges on the Banks of The Thames’ as the scene is set; the dislocating jeopardy of its mid-point ‘We Can Still Win This’; the third-rail sparking danger of its final act, ‘Consistent Effort’, and the…

ai.en: Iceage play Electric Brixton, presented by FORM. The band's Elias Ronnenfelt writes from the same place of grit as before.

events.description: FORM Presents ICEAGE Iceage’s Elias Rønnenfelt still writes from a place of grit “out amongst the dead,” but today it is animated. "Star" is a total love song. Its subject awakens its singer and everything around them. It whips the scaffold sheeting; it breathes life. The song, too, is animated: a sixteenth-note jangle pulse with room for twinkling guitar, for slashy guitar, for soaring, and for tension. Out- of-nowhere handclaps arrive as an enthusiastic answer, a groovy proof. What love makes you feel like a dying star? A star’s death is the catastrophic culmination. A traceless extinguishing of everything. There is no bigger event. Living inside total collapse, however, and feeling an incandescent present, is perhaps the biggest high we might feel. Over 18 years and 5 studio albums, each an evolutionary jump and a new vein of playing, Iceage have worked inside the idea of collapse. It is a way of playing, singing and songwriting—almost falling apart and pulling together on time. A tumbling through life in song, catching it as it goes.
Doors open at 5pm, two hours before the event starts

Moving from powerful progressive jazz fusion to atmospheric psychedelia to free improvised jazz-rock, the Soft Machine's ability to bring various sounds together has always pushed them into new musical forms of innovation. Adam Green is an artistic polymath - a songwriter, filmmaker, and visual artist whose work blends fleshy humor and metaphysical surrealism. As co-founder of the antifolk band The Moldy Peaches, he helped define a generation of raw, emotionally candid music. Since then, Green has released twelve solo albums, and In 2023 received a tribute album Moping In Style - which brought together the voices of Father John Misty, The Libertines, Frankie Cosmos, Devendra Banhart and Sean Ono Lennon covering Green’s songs. Green’s creative reach extends beyond songwriting. His paintings and sculptures have been exhibited across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, including a landmark show at the Fondation Beyeler in Basel. He has directed two full-length movies - The Wrong Ferarri (2010), the first feature film shot entirely on an iPhone, and Adam Green's Aladdin (2016), the hand-built fantasy epic which Buzzfeed called “the trippiest movie ever made.” His recent work explores the interconnected mythology of his “Houseface” universe through poetry books, essays, and graphic novels. ai.en: Elder play Electric Brixton with Temple Fang and Rezn, presented by Desertscene London. The band marks two decades of its existence.

events.description: Desertscene London proudly presents ELDER plus special guests TEMPLE FANG, REZN Two decades into their existence, Elder remain an anomaly in the underground rock scene - a rare band with the ability to absorb and shed influences from a myriad of genres without falling into pastiche or losing their own identity. Their new record Through Zero is a strong reaffirmation of a commitment to pushing boundaries in the world of heavy rock and cements the group’s status as leaders of the pack in heavy psychedelic rock. Elder has long since mastered crushing riffs, melodic jaunts, progressive patterns, hypnotic grooves and ethereal atmosphere along their path of music-making in the past twenty years. On Through Zero, Elder takes these years of experience and forms possibly their most immediate and engaging record to date, while allowing seeds from outside the sphere of rock music to take root and bloom within their progressive framework. Listeners will find familiar elements of new textures, sequences, and sounds alongside Elder’s iconic take on heavy rock. As always, every spin reveals new details. Recorded in Berlin across several months between tours in 2025, Through Zero is the first album which the band not only produced but also co-mixed together with longtime collaborator Richard Behrens. The album sounds more like a full extension of the band’s creative intentions than ever before. Elder was founded sometime around 2006 or so - nobody remembers exactly - in a small coastal town…

ai.en: Blind Channel, a Finnish nu metal band from Oulu, play Underworld on the Painstream tour. The band represented Finland in the Eurovision Song Contest.

events.description: PAINSTREAM TOUR BLIND CHANNEL are a Finnish Nu Metal band from Oulu. They represented Finland in the Eurovision Song Contest 2021 with the song "Dark Side", finishing in sixth place. The band define their musical style as "Violent Pop". In February 2021, the band participated in the Finnish national selection for the Eurovision Song Contest 2021 with the modern Nu-Metal track "Dark Side". They won the selection with 54.3% of the vote (the highest in UMK history) and in May 2021 represented Finland in the contest in Rotterdam, Netherlands, finishing in sixth place with a total of 301 points. BLIND CHANNEL received 218 of their total points from televoting, while 83 points were received from juries. The band painted their middle fingers red for their Eurovision performance of "Dark Side", after being informed that they could not lift a middle finger to the audience onstage due to the show's family-friendly nature. On 19 May 2021, a day before their first performance at Eurovision, the band signed to Century Media/Sony Music. On 7 October 2024, the band announced that they would be going on indefinite hiatus. On 26 April 2025, Joel Hokka announced he would not be returning to the band, citing insomnia issues. On 5 August 2026, the band announced their return from their hiatus, and revealed their upcoming album, Painstream, which is set for release on 30 October.
