Charlotte Adigéry & Bolis Pupul are a Ghent-based electronic duo. Hailed as “club provocateurs” by the Guardian, their sharp, joyous electro-pop takes its cues from heroes like Grace Jones and David Byrne. Their critically acclaimed 2022 debut album Topical Dancer, released via Soulwax’s DEEWEE label, tackled racism, misogyny, post-colonialism and social media vanity with wit and whimsy. It earned co-signs from BBC 6 Music, Pitchfork (Best New Music), The Guardian, the Los Angeles Times, AnOther and more. They’ve since performed on Later... with Jools Holland, won three MIAs at home in Belgium, and sold out headline shows and played stages around the world, from Glastonbury and Sónar to Big Ears and Pitchfork Music Festival Chicago. Now the pair return with Mainland Madinina, due in February 2027. The album took shape as both artists experienced major changes in their personal lives. Adigéry became a mother and lost her father to Alzheimer’s disease, and Pupul later became a father and released his solo album Letter to Yu, inspired by his late mother’s homeland of Hong Kong. The album is named for their respective places of origin: mainland China and Hong Kong for Pupul (for his grandparents and mother respectively), and Madinina, the Indigenous name for the Caribbean island of Martinique, for Adigéry (for her mother). Written in Belgium and Martinique and once again co-produced with Soulwax, it explores grief, parenthood, diaspora and colonial history. Its hybrid sound…

ai.en: HMLTD play Village Underground, with their third album FANGS, to be released on 23 October 2026. The album is a change from their 2023 release.

events.description: HMLTD’s third album, FANGS (to be released 23 October, 2026), could not be further away from their last outing, 2023 rock opera The Worm. A return to the band’s origins as purveyors of violent, genre-pushing experimentation, and avant-garde provocation and confrontation, Fangs is a total reinvention and rehabilitation of the goth genre, through the looking glass of post-internet electronic and doomscroll-era dance music. In HMLTD’s version of dance music, cacophonous sub-bass becomes a chthonic call of the void; seraphic rave synths the screech of Valkyries; four-to-the-floor a deathly funeral march. Vampire apocalypse. The result is both unique and terrifying, modern and original, and the dawn of a new era the band call Götherdammerüng - Wagner’s ‘Twilight of the Gods’ made Goth. Devoted disciples of Wagner’s notion of the Gesamtkunstwerk (or ‘total artwork’), Fangs is the band’s latest exercise in expansive world-building; a practice they have perfected over their near-decade in London’s underground music scene. Their uncompromising live shows have achieved cult status for going far beyond the boundaries of an ordinary gig, harnessing elaborate set design, costume, actors and performance artists to create immersive, multi-sensory, participatory live experiences that blur the boundary between audience and artist. For their 2022 show at Heaven, the band interrogated freedom and authority; building a ‘fictional totalitarian state’ called ‘The Order’ inside the venue, complete…

title.en: NOUVELLE VAGUE 'A Date with Depeche Mode'

ai.en: Nouvelle Vague perform A Date with Depeche Mode at KOKO, presented by AGMP Concerts. The bossa nova project was founded in 2003 by Marc Collin and Olivier Libaux.

events.description: AGMP Presents Nouvelle Vague, the renowned bossa nova project founded by Marc Collin and the late Olivier Libaux in 2003, are returning to the UK in style in Spring 2027 to celebrate the release of their seventh album, A Date with Depeche Mode. Nouvelle Vague are reinventing themselves again by dedicating an entire album to the repertoire of a single band for the first time: Depeche Mode. Thirteen iconic songs have been recreated and reinterpreted by new voices. Recorded in Rio with Brazilian musicians, the album establishes a dialogue between the musical soul of Brazil and Depeche Mode's timeless world, revisited with the Nouvelle Vague touch. The first single from 'A Date with Depeche Mode' is a duet of 'Enjoy the Silence' performed by Skye Edwards (Morcheeba) and Larry Love (Alabama 3) alongside Nouvelle Vague. Two voices, two worlds — one song. Recorded in Rio de Janeiro with some of Brazil's best musicians, the track strips back the Depeche Mode classic to breathe new life into it. Nouvelle Vague at their best. This bespoke tour by a band at the very top of their game is not to be missed. 14+ only. 14s to 15s must be accompanied by an adult. No refunds will be given for incorrectly booked tickets

Since forming in in 2015, the group—vocalist Patrick Miranda, guitarist/bassist Austin Cressey, guitarist Ira George and drummer Spencer York—have transformed from a scrappy post-hardcore act to bonafide headliners who have over 775 million lifetime streams and have taken some of their biggest inspirations such as Tigers Jaw and Citizen out on the road as opening acts. title.en: The Menzingers – Everything I Ever Saw Tour

ai.en: The Menzingers play the Everything I Ever Saw Tour at Electric Brixton on Saturday, 13 March, with The Flatliners as special guests, presented by Action..

events.description: Action! presents The Menzingers – Everything I Ever Saw Tour + Special Guests The Flatliners Saturday 13 March 2027 Electric Brixton Everything I Ever Saw finds the Menzingers entering a new era in what’s already been a storied career. The Philadelphia punk legends’ eighth album chronicles moments of significant change—the personal, the political, and the universal—while returning to the core creative principles that first put them on the map with listeners the world over. Twenty years in, the Menzingers have discovered that the wisdom gained with time’s passing is even stronger than the emotional armor they once wore in their youth, and Everything I Ever Saw captures the quartet embracing the here and now while strengthening the bonds that have held them together. Work on Everything I Ever Saw started in earnest after touring behind 2023’s Some Of It Was True, as the group felt a re-energized urgency while their worlds changed around them. “It wasn't something that we initially set out to do,” vocalist/guitarist Greg Barnett says. “We started writing immediately after our last record in a very fun, casual way—but we were going through really special moments that we wanted to document.” “We've been doing this for so long that it’s routine,” vocalist/guitarist Tom May adds. “Between this record and the last record, however, so much happened in our lives, and we always write about what's going on.” Indeed, the last three years have been plenty busy in the Menzingers’ world…

Diary of Dreams is the darkwave project of Adrian Hates, formed in Düsseldorf, Germany in 1989. Built around Hates’ voice, programmed rhythms and guitar, the project became one of the central names in German dark-scene music across albums such as “Cholymelan”, “Bird Without Wings”, “Nigredo” and “Nekrolog 43”. Hates has run the project through its own label, Accession Records, and remained its constant creative centre while the live line-up changed over the years. Recent Diary of Dreams activity includes the orchestral reworking “Under a timeless Spell” and the “Dead End Dreams” series on Accession. The electronic-duet format adds another live configuration alongside the full band, applied to shows billed specifically as Diary of Dreams – the electronic duet, beginning with the project’s announced 2026 dates. Diary of Dreams have announced a new live format. Adrian Hates and Felix Wunderer will appear on selected international stages as Diary of Dreams – the electronic duet, focusing on the purely electronic side of the project. As Adrian Hates comments: “the Electronic Duet” concerts are additional to playing live with the normal line up – NOT a replacement! – I was just sick and tired of not touring anymore in so many territories due to generally rising costs. This is my way of dealing with it. of course you still have a point here…

Today, the church is part of SAINT, a thriving church meeting across multiple East London locations. Following a multi-million-pound restoration, part-funded by the National Lottery Heritage Fund, the church has undergone a substantial transformation, driven by a vision to create a 'cathedral of creativity' to serve the local community and beyond. This project was spearheaded by an acclaimed team including world-renowned minimalist architect John Pawson CBE, visual artist Es Devlin, and conservation experts Thomas Ford & Partners. The renovation not only improved the church’s accessibility but also meticulously preserved its historical integrity, establishing it as an impressive centre for community engagement. Hackney Church functions as a premier venue for live music, arts and culture, intertwined with Hackney's cultural and social landscape. events.description: Named after a 9th century Indian saint and poet king, Kula Shaker seemed to have always existed in an alternate reality. Emerging in the midst of Britpop's lad-culture swagger and retrograde cool, Kula Shaker appeared like a luminous anomaly flooded with Sanskrit and sitar-drenched feedback. Fronted by the spiritually restless Crispian Mills, the band carved out their own mystical counter-narrative, fusing British psychedelia and eastern mysticism that felt less like a gimmick and more like an invocation.

Born in Algiers and now based in Paris, TIF has established himself as one of the most distinctive voices on the French-speaking music scene. Blending rap and melody, French and Arabic, he has developed a deeply personal musical universe shaped by exile, memory and dual cultural identity. He now announces the international continuation of the SAVASHUIA TOUR, with a headline show at KOKO. Following a first run of numerous sold-out shows, the 14-track project marks a new chapter in his artistic journey, exploring new sounds while preserving the authenticity and emotional depth that define his work. Since his beginnings, TIF has also developed a distinctive stage identity, notably through his live sessions, which have become one of the defining features of his musical universe, reaching millions of views. Joined by his musicians, he delivers organic performances where live arrangements, improvisation and spontaneity bring a new dimension to his tracks.

events.description: Patrick Bebey celebrates the music of his father Francis, Cameroon’s pioneer of African electronic music. Long before it was commonplace, Francis Bebey paired the sanza thumb piano and pygmy flute with drum machines and synths, building a warm, playful sound entirely his own. Decades on, his records have been reissued, sampled and remixed by a new generation of artists, finding audiences far beyond Cameroon. Music was always a family affair for the Bebeys. Patrick played on his father’s records and stage shows for years and now looks after the archive of tapes he left behind. Led by the son who knows these songs best, this is a celebration of Francis Bebey’s music, bringing its homemade spirit to our stage. Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. events.description: Michelle’s 7th bedroom produced album – It Was the Moment – will not disappoint those anticipating a new soundtrack for their darkness and saudade. It may even be her most vulnerable and expressive work yet, not unsurprising as it was written and produced during a period of grief and mental instability. There’s a new level of emotional surrender in these songs, confirming her place in the lineage of dramatic chansonniers. Themes include a fatalistic submission to passion, the ephemeral nature of encounters, the loss of mother and home, the end of days, and losing one’s mind in both the best and worst ways possible. Michelle offers her entire palette of sound here, from dark Lynchian realism, to elegant humor, to queen of epic melodrama. With shows regularly selling out in cities like Istanbul, Berlin, Warsaw and Athens, Michelle has established a niche that includes the East-European diaspora, the Berlin queer scene, and those with a taste for the melodramatic balladry of Charles Aznavour, Zeki Müren and Nikolai Slichenko. While her concerts include more live aspects and a line-up of musicians, she continues to self-produce and release her own albums, maintaining an intimacy and singleness of expression – from her bedroom to yours. A genre based partly on elements of melody and style, but moreso, a signature fatalist-celebratory approach to songwriting. events.description: PRE-SALE: THURSDAY 3 DECEMBER AT 10AM GMT. GENERAL SALE: THURSDAY 3 DECEMBER AT 12PM GMT. *RSVP for first access to limited, pre-sale exclusive £12 early bird tickets now. --- We are proud to welcome back a bastion of the analog-centred, vinyl-first, ‘journey’ set school of DJing. Parisian groove-master Jeremy Underground will kick off your Easter Bank Holiday Weekend (no work the next day)... Armed with a record bag shaped by 15+ years of relentless crate digging, Jeremy is credited with unearthing some of the most infectious dance music releases of his generation. Not just in house music (his primary passion), but in funk, gospel and Levan-era disco. A favourite (and regular back-to-back partner) of contemporaries à la Floating Points, MCDE, Kerri Chandler, Antal and more, Jeremy’s sets are dripping with a feeling often missing from today’s digitised clubland: passion, heart & soul. Beyond the turntables, Jeremy holds acclaimed tastemaker status thanks to My Love Is Underground, a wildly successful vinyl-only label whose releases single-handedly rejuvenated a global passion for the classic NYC house sound it’s inspired by. For dancers searching for something transformative, this is your party.

events.description: Osibisa has criss-cross rhythms that explode with happiness.” - Nile Rodgers Globally renowned as the founding fathers of Afro-rock, Osibisa bring a high-octane celebration of Ghana’s rich musical heritage to our stage. Formed in London in 1969 by West African and Caribbean musicians led by the late Teddy Osei, the band forged a bold new sound blending rock, highlife, funk and Caribbean influences — becoming the first taste of African music for many UK audiences. With joyous anthems like ‘Sunshine Day’, ‘Woyaya’ and ‘Music for Gong Gong’, their live shows remain legendary — a euphoric mix of uplifting rhythms, rip-roaring brass and irresistible grooves. ai.en: Spiritualized play Acoustic Mainlines at Union Chapel, presented by Kilimanjaro Live. Under-16s must be accompanied by an adult.

events.description: Kilimanjaro Live Presents Spiritualized: Acoustic Mainlines + Special Guests under 16s to be accompanied by an adult aged 18 and over To celebrate the 20th anniversary of their first-ever acoustic performances, Spiritualized are set to perform four rare Acoustic Mainlines shows in the UK.Conceived around the time of the making of the Songs In A&E album, and after J Spaceman had survived serious illness, the shows originally grew out of an appearance at a Daniel Johnston show at the Barbican where Spaceman and Spiritualized guitarist, Tony Doggen Foster, performed covers of Johnston’s Devil Town, Funeral Home and True Love Will Find You In The End. As Spaceman later recalled: “I was under weight and battered and this was a gentle way of getting back on stage. It wasn’t my show for a start, and it was small, and it was beautiful. Originally, it was just going to be the two of us, but we ended up getting the strings and the choir and because it worked so well, it led to other things.”The Acoustic Mainline shows that followed featured songs from across the Spacemen 3 and Spiritualized catalogues as well as various cover versions. The same will be true this time round - and once again, J Spaceman will be accompanied on all dates by a string quartet, gospel singers and Spiritualized guitarist Tony Foster

title.en: Ministry: Hate To Go - Goodbye Europe 2027

ai.en: Ministry: Hate To Go Goodbye Europe 2027 plays Troxy. The band's founder, Al Jourgensen, is leaving the stage.

events.description: Attention planet Earth: Ministry visionary Al Jourgensen is leaving the building. With a history built upon 17 studio albums, 8 live releases, 6 side projects, multiple touring campaigns across 5 continents, an autobiography, 2 documentaries, the administration of last rites no less than 3 times, and the countless numbers of devoted acolytes and fans, the aural and charismatic magus of Ministry is boarding up the door in his psychic studio for the final time. Fortunately, Jourgensen is leaving us with one final sonic salvo: The final Ministry LP, Hate To Go (Take Out Or Delivery) that enters the world October 30 via Cleopatra Records. Expect pointed commentaries, the return of longtime associate Paul Barker and adventures in Ai, all delivered with the patented whiplash urgency listeners have come to recognize, respect, and break the occasional bone over.

Quiet, spacious and deeply felt, the piano music of Norwegian composer Vetle Nærø invites you to slow down and simply listen. Rooted in minimalism, his pieces grow from a handful of carefully chosen notes into moments of raw emotion and meditative calm. His music continues to shape his artistic identity in an ever-expanding world of modern classical music, offering powerful experiences marked by quiet intensity, clarity and deep emotional resonance. Following their sold-out London show last year, legendary Turkish rock band DUMAN are returning to London for another unforgettable night! Catch them live at Troxy on 16 April 2027. Formed in Istanbul in 1999, DUMAN have become one of the most iconic names in Turkish rock. From their legendary debut album Eski Köprünün Altinda to countless timeless anthems that have defined generations, their music continues to resonate with fans across the world. With their latest album KUFi, released after 11 years, DUMAN continue to evolve while staying true to their unmistakable sound. After an unforgettable and sold-out London show, DUMAN are back. Don't miss the chance to experience one of Turkey's most iconic rock bands live in London once again!

ai.en: Martin Stephenson and The Daintees play Hare and Hounds, presented by AGMP Concerts. The band comes from the North East of England, and its debut single was Roll On.

events.description: AGMP Presents Martin Stephenson & The Daintees hail from the North East of England. Their debut single 'Roll On Summertime' was released in 1982 on Kitchenware Records (home of Prefab Sprout, The Kane Gang, Hurrah!). 'Boat To Bolivia' was the debut album by Martin Stephenson & The Daintees. After appearances on Channel 4's 'The Tube' and BBC2's 'Whistle Test' the album went on to become one of the essential releases of 1986. In 1988, the second Martin Stephenson & The Daintees album 'Gladsome, Humour & Blue' was released which featured the singles 'There Comes A Time' & 'Wholly Humble Heart'. Don't miss Martin Stephenson & The Daintees perform music from the 'Gladsome, Humour & Blue' LP along with other classics and fan favourites. An AGMP Concerts presentation.

events.description: Calling all you over 30s! Old School Indie is coming back to Scala, Kings Cross for another indie DAYTIME party as part of Club de Fromage's daytime clubbing event. TWO clubs for the price of one! We'll be taking over the upstairs room at the the legendary Scala to bring you 4 hours of non-stop indie bangers whilst Club de Fromage host the main room playing their classic blend of retro pop. The best bit, you can wander between the two rooms as much as you like. Kicking off at 3pm until 7pm you can expect 4 hours of non-stop indie/rock faves from the likes of Blur, The Clash, Pulp, The Smiths, David Bowie, The Cure, Arctic Monkeys, Blondie, The Strokes, The Jam, Nirvana, Oasis, Joy Division and more Should you, for any bizarre reason, want to leave the indie club you're free to wander in and out of the adjoining downstairs venue where Club de Fromage will be playing pop from the likes of ABBA, Queen, Britney, Whitney, The Spice Girls, Bon Jovi, Prince, Daft Punk, Wham!, Fleetwood Mac, Madonna, A-Ha, and more, as well as the Fromage stage show. We'll be finished by 7pm so you'll be free to swan off and spend your evening in a swanky restaurant, at the cinema or just go straight home and flop in front of the TV with a good old Saturday night takeaway. There is a strict door policy of no under 30s, so please bring ID as you will be asked to show it, and no you can't bring your 21 year old mate, so don't bother asking.

Jazz, electronica and the sounds of Bengal come together in the music of South London’s Tara Lily. A singer, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist, she lets her soulful voice carry echoes of her heritage, floating over the rolling rhythms of the tabla and brooding electronics. Raised by a Scottish punk singer and a Bengali folk musician, she grew up absorbing everything from alternative RnB to classical Indian music. That rich tapestry of influences, paired with her deep musical insight, forms the foundation of a sound that is entirely her own, one that has taken her from opening for Raye to making a record with King Krule. With a new album on the way, she brings her latest music to our stage. Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. CLICK HERE to see a detailed seat map of the restaurant. ai.en: Evil Blizzard, a band from Preston with three bass players and a guitarist, play the 100 Club.

events.description: Preston’s Evil Blizzard are truly an enigma. A mystery. A baffling conundrum. Three bass players, a guitarist, a singing drummer, an array of rubber masks that will give both children and adults sleepless nights for days on end, laying there, sweating, convulsing – they are the most ingenious and charismatic live experience on the music scene today.Evil Blizzard delve into many musical genres. From Krautrock to pop to even heavy dub. No genre is safe from their reach. But who are their influences? Who do they appeal to? Filthy Dirty explained in a recent interview. “People with more money than taste, ideally. We seem to have a similar appeal right across any genre; metal, indie, dance, goth, dub; you name it – we can annoy anyone. We could start a new ‘goth/dub’ genre. We’re the kings of Gub.”Opening for such diverse acts as Space, Sleaford Mods, Ruts DC, Gnod, Hawkwind, Killing Joke, Public Image Limited, Bo Ningen and Embrace. Blizzard have not only won over partisan crowds but have gone on to conquer such music festivals as Kendal Calling, Supersonic, Rebellion, The Great British Alternative Music Festival and The International Festival of Psychedelia in Liverpool. With a new album due in Spring 2026, it is time to once again get EVIL.

Live Nation Presents Kane Brown Following the phenomenal success of his sold-out “Don’t Listen To Me” UK tour, acclaimed comedian, actor, and presenter Kane Brown has announced his highly anticipated new live show, Crowd Work King, set to tour the UK in 2026. Renowned for his fast wit, commanding stage presence, and razor-sharp improvisational skills, Kane Brown brings audiences an entirely new kind of comedy experience. Crowd Work King is one hour of purely unscripted, unplanned, and unpredictable stand-up where no two shows are ever the same. Built entirely around audience participation, every moment is created live and in real time. Unlike traditional stand-up, Kane steps on stage with no script, no set list, and no safety net letting the energy of the room guide the show. What unfolds is a raw, hilarious, and completely unique night of comedy where the audience becomes part of the performance. Kane’s quick thinking and spontaneous creativity have earned him a reputation as one of the UK’s most gifted improvisers. Each show offers an experience that’s unrepeatable from sharp comebacks and crowd banter to stories sparked by the people in the room. Whether you’re in the front row or the back, you never know when you might become part of the act. “Kane Brown is the most naturally talented standup with a crowd I’ve ever seen.”— Guz Khan BAR & DINER OPEN FROM 7PM Strictly 18’s and over

‘Rocks’ is the new single from Naima Bock, to be released on the 11th November via Breakfast Records/Fire Talk. Her first music since the highly acclaimed Below A Massive Dark Land (2024) and standalone single Rolling (2025), it's a close and intimate preview into the new material she’s been debuting across recent tours with Neil Young, Dinosaur Jr.and Jake Xerxes Fussell. These have seen her experimenting with stripped back two and three-piece setups, often rearranging the detailed arrangements and percussive flourishes that so often graced previous records, and embracing a more direct approach to songwriting. Naima Bock has an ever rising profile in both the UK and US. Her previous records Giant Palm (2022) and Below A Massive Dark Land (2024) received extensive praise, including glowing reviews from Pitchfork, Stereogum, Uncut and Mojo, as well as support from Lauren Laverne, Marc Riley, Gideon Coe on 6Music. Giant Palm and Below were also mainstays on KEXP, with Naima performing two sessions in 2023 and 2024, and she more recently played at the 6Music Festival in early 2026. “Exquisite […] a truly special listen" Clash “A ray of optimism” The Guardian “The fusion of her disparate cultural influences makes for an enchanting sound entirely Bock’s own” New York Times

title.en: Nicola Conte Umoja Live feat. Zara McFarlane

events.description: Nicola Conte brings the joyful, globe spanning sound of Umoja to our stage, with Zara McFarlane on vocals. Named after the Swahili word for unity, Umoja is music built for moving to, drawing on the 70s cosmic jazz and African and Afro Caribbean rhythms that fill Conte’s record collection, with a nod to Fela Kuti and Tony Allen’s Afrobeat. Recorded live to analogue tape, it crackles with the energy of a band playing together in one room, as at home on the dancefloor as it is on the turntable. A DJ, producer, guitarist and bandleader, Conte is a lifelong crate digger with a knack for spotting great voices early, championing Gregory Porter and José James in Europe long before they became household names. Here he and McFarlane bring their collaboration to our stage, with the voice behind ‘Arise’ joining him for a night of their music together. Enjoy a view overlooking the stage from our mezzanine restaurant. CLICK HERE to see a detailed seat map of the restaurant. This event is strictly 18+ with ID required on arrival at the venue.

events.description: AGMP Presents THE STYLE COUNCILLORS 'Café Bleu' Tour The seminal debut album recreated live by the world's only tribute to The Style Council. The Style Councillors will be recreating the seminal debut LP by The Style Council, 'Café Bleu', along with all of the hits and classics in the finest celebration of Paul Weller's 1980's group where some of his best songs were recorded. After the dissolution of The Jam in 1982, Paul Weller joined forces with Mick Talbot, formerly of The Merton Parkas, Dexys Midnight Runners and The Bureau, to form The Style Council. The band released a string of successful singles between 1983-1989 such as Speak Like a Child, Money-Go-Round, Long Hot Summer, My Ever Changing Moods, You're The Best Thing, Shout To The Top, Walls Come Tumbling Down, A Solid Bond In Your Heart, Come To Milton Keynes, The Lodgers, Why I Went Missing, and more. The Style Councillors are a 9-piece band who were formed in 2013 by Darren Fletcher. Having quickly built a hugely loyal fanbase The Style Councillors are in big demand on the live circuit for fans of Paul Weller and The Style Council. An AGMP Concerts presentation. They take that heritage somewhere new by combining flamenco tradition with club-ready electronica and deep funk grooves. The result sounds both rooted and completely of the moment. Their second album, Lugar nº0 (DLY), short for Don’t Lose Yourself, keeps the duo’s signature sound and pushes it further, with touches of jazz, jungle, Japanese city pop and salsa. Acclaimed Portuguese singer and Eurovision winner Salvador Sobral presents his first-ever album featuring exclusively Brazilian composers. Titled “A Flor do Recomeço” (The Flower of Restarting), the album was recorded in São Paulo and produced by Brazilians Marcus Preto and Tó Brandileone , with a release scheduled for the second half of the year. The record features a stellar lineup of previously unreleased songs written specifically for Sobral by renowned artists such as Adriana Calcanhotto, Arnaldo Antunes, Chico César, Céu, Marcelo Camelo, Mallu Magalhães, Marcos Valle, and Tim Bernardes. The title is drawn from a poem by writer Eveline Sin, set to music by Chico César. For Sobral, this project is a deeply personal journey back to his musical foundations: “I am absolutely convinced that music was born in Brazil. I grew up listening to Maria Bethânia in my mother’s car and Chico César in my father’s. This album stems from the need to go to the supreme origin to deepen and uncover the timeless sounds of this side of the Atlantic. Brought to life on stage by a premier lineup of musicians: Katerina L'dokova (piano), André Rosinha (double bass), Joel Silva (drums and percussion), Sebastià Gris (guitars), and Eva Fernández (sax).

Moreno Veloso grew up surrounded by music as the son of Caetano Veloso, and has since toured the world in his father's band. Old Empire Presents 16 Horsepower Friday 30th April 2027 Electric Brixton 16 Horsepower stands as the band that fundamentally altered the landscape for roots- based, alternative music drawing heavily on the raw intensity and timbres of Appalachian folk, bluegrass, gospel, and country—employing traditional instruments such as banjo, Chemnitzer concertina, hurdy-gurdy, lap steel, and upright bass—and filtering these sounds through a modern, rock-informed sensibility. This cross-pollination pioneered a genre-defying substyle variously labeled “gothic country,” “gothic Americana,” and, within Denver’s fertile 1990s alternative scene, “The Denver Sound”. With a core trio of David Eugene Edwards, Jean Yves Tola and Pascal Humbert consistently at the helm, a shifting cast of collaborators, and a restless drive to push boundaries, they left behind an unmistakable sonic and thematic fingerprint. Whether channeling fire-and-brimstone sermons, haunted ballads, or folk standards reimagined through a modern, tormented lens, 16 Horsepower forged a body of work that is both intimately American and universally gothic in its vision. Their legacy continued in 2026 when16 Horsepower announced their European reunion with the core trio of musicians reuniting to present their beloved music again for the first time since November 22, 2005. In 2027, this reunion makes its long awaited return to the UK.

events.description: AGMP Presents THE PRIMITIVES + CLOSE LOBSTERS The Primitives are celebrating the 40th anniversary of 'Stop Killing Me', their iconic number one indie single in 2027. Close Lobsters are celebrating the 40th anniversary of 'Foxheads Stalk This Land', their timeless 1987 debut LP in 2027. Fronted by indie pop blonde bombshell Tracy Tracy, The Primitives emerged from the independent scene of the mid-80s that also spawned The Jesus and Mary Chain, My Bloody Valentine, The Wedding Present, and Primal Scream. Their sound distilled the shimmering guitar jangle of The Byrds, the buzzsaw style of the Ramones and 60's girl group melodies into two and a half minute pop gems. The Primitives were regular session guests on BBC Radio One's John Peel radio show and they had a career boost when Morrissey named them as one of his favourite bands. Their widely acclaimed first album, Lovely, made them the UK's indie darlings, while the huge success of the single Crash saw them cross over to a mass audience. Lovely also featured the singles Thru the Flowers, Stop Killing Me, Way Behind Me and Out of Reach. Further chart success followed, along with two more studio albums, Pure and Galore, before the band called it a day in 1992. In 2008, Mojo Magazine voted The Primitives' second single Really Stupid one of the Top 40 UK indie singles of all time. Close Lobsters are a Scottish indie pop group formed in 1985. Their first release 'Firestation Towers' came out on the iconic NME C86 compilation…

Two of the most original Latin American voices in Europe share the stage for an exciting double bill. Both are women with roots in Latin America, Venezuela and Mexico, who have made their home in Europe. Both are bandleaders who write and play their own music, and both are about to release new albums. La Chica is Sophie Fustec, a French-Venezuelan singer, pianist and producer. Her roots are in the mountains of Venezuela and in Belleville, the multilingual Paris neighbourhood where she grew up. Her 2020 album La Loba was a tribute to her late brother and a meditation on the worlds women carry within them. Her new album adds electronic textures to her signature blend of piano, voice and Latin American roots. La Chica show is more than a performance: it's a ritual Fuensanta is a Mexican singer, double bassist, composer and improviser from Veracruz, now based in Amsterdam. She grew up in the cloud forest of Tlalnehuayocan, and her music mixes son jarocho, jazz and experimental sounds with simple, surreal poetry. She has worked with Snarky Puppy, Silvia Pérez Cruz and Louis Cole, and played North Sea Jazz and the Kennedy Center. She brings songs from her debut studio album, Trenodia y Pirita, co-produced with Snarky Puppy's Michael League and out on GroundUp in early 2027. Mexican Institute of Sound (M.I.S.) brings a Mexican Independence Day celebration led by Grammy-winning producer and pioneer of Mexican electronica, Camilo Lara. Blending cumbia, mariachi and cha-cha-cha with sharp electronic production, M.I.S. turns decades of Mexican sound into a driving, club-ready live experience. Lara’s work spans Coco, Narcos, Breaking Bad and Grand Theft Auto: East Los FM, alongside collaborations with Beck, Norah Jones, and the Beastie Boys. Standby as we welcome back Junglist godfather & bonafide teacher: Congo Natty. Natty is one of the UK’s most influential underground music visionaries. He spent decades fusing reggae, dub, roots and dancehall influences with the raw breakbeat energy of Drum & Bass, shaping the sound we know and love as Jungle. He’ll bring some of the sounds best exports alongside him on the night as we push our soundsystem to it’s limits. Lock in for a spiritual journey through the raw energy of Jungle, DnB & Bass music.

Technical death metal architects REVOCATION will release their new full-length New Gods, New Masters on September 26th via Metal Blade Records! REVOCATION creates extreme music for extreme times. On New Gods, New Masters, their fifth record for Metal Blade, the quartet – spearheaded by founder/vocalist/guitarist Dave Davidson – delivers nine potent and portentous songs of brutal lyrical and musical significance. While their critically-lauded, 2022-released Netherheaven full-length set a high bar for the band, an even sharper musical and lyrical focus was achieved on New Gods, New Masters. The Boston-bred Davidson credits newest members Harry Lannon (rhythm guitar and backing vocals since 2023) and bassist Alex Weber with a renewed energy and intensity both in the studio and onstage. “It’s been a pleasure ripping with those guys alongside Ash (Pearson), who always crushes it behind the kit,” he notes. In terms of his own playing, writing, and singing he adds, “I’m always refining my craft and trying to get better.” Titling the album New Gods, New Masters reflects Davidson’s belief about humans’ need to worship various gods. “It seems as if that desire is encoded in our DNA. As science and our understanding of nature and the universe as a whole increases, the religions of the old gods start to become obsolete,” he says. “However, I believe we’ve replaced our old gods with new ones, worshipping technology and creating a cult-like idolatry of innovators. I’ve been very…

events.description: On a bed of deep, rolling bass, Jah Wobble and Invaders of the Heart build a hypnotic world of dub, punk and global grooves. As a founding member of Public Image Ltd, Wobble’s bass drove post-punk classics like ‘Public Image’ and ‘Death Disco’, before Invaders of the Heart carried his sound across the globe, from Middle Eastern melodies to heavyweight takes on film themes like Get Carter. Born John Wardle in Stepney, Jah Wobble got his name from his friend, the Sex Pistols’ Sid Vicious, who slurred it after a drunken night out and later lent him his first bass. Since forming Invaders of the Heart in 1982, he has been continuing to turn the reggae records of his East London youth into a language entirely his own. AGMP Presents AGMP Concerts present MATT BIANCO + special guests Matt Bianco is a UK group formed in 1982 by Mark Reilly (vocals), Danny White (keyboards) and Kito Poncioni (bass), from the ashes of Blue Rondo A La Turk. Their first album Whose Side Are You On? (1984) featured unknown polish vocalist Basia. The LP turned Matt Bianco into one of the biggest acts of the 1980's with hits such as Get Out Of Your Lazy Bed, Half A Minute, & More Than I Can Bear. Basia and Danny White left the group after the first album to pursue a solo-career under the name Basia. Mark Reilly worked with keyboardist Mark Fisher for the next self titled LP Matt Bianco (1986) which included the big hit Yeh Yeh. The next Matt Bianco LP Indigo (1988) was produced by Gloria Estefan's husband Emilio Estefan and included the singles Don't Blame It On That Girl, Good Times & Wap Bam Boogie. Matt Bianco continue to this day collaborating with the cream of UK Jazz musicians along with two incredible albums with Dutch Latin jazz crew New Cool Collective in recent times. events.description: Doors 6.30pm | Event Calendar CLICK HERE After her SOLD OUT Debut at Soul Mama, we are looking forward to hosting Natalie May's return with a saturday night to remember! Natalie May is a London-based singer-songwriter shaping a sound she calls Lofi-Soul, a seamless blend of velvety R&B, lo-fi textures and sultry jazz undertones. Her songwriting favours space over excess, allowing subtle grooves, brushed rhythms and silky melodies to carry stories of reflection, gratitude and love. Inspired by Nat King Cole, Mariah Carey and D'Angelo, Natalie bridges smooth soul with a contemporary groove that feels nostalgic and forward-leaning. She has brought her soulful sound to major stages including Wembley Arena and Glastonbury Festival, and has supported acclaimed artists such as Teedra Moses and Grammy Award-winning Robert Glasper on his sold-out UK dates. Natalie May continues to cultivate a refined, intimate musical experience, one that invites listeners to slow down, settle in, and stay awhile. The Soul Mama Menu offers a delightful blend of African, Caribbean, and South American cuisine. Soul Mama was listed in the “top restaurants to look forward to in 2024 list” by the Evening Standard. Please take a moment to explore our menu. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

AGMP Presents SPEAKING IN TONGUES - TALKING HEADS: 1977-2027 50 years since the debut LP was released by Talking Heads 'Talking Heads: 77', Speaking in Tongues celebrate the iconic album performing selections from the album along with the hits and fan favourites from the Talking Heads back catalgoue. Talking Heads formed in New York City in 1975. The group consisted of David Byrne on vocals and guitar, Chris Frantz on drums, Tina Weymouth on bass, and Jerry Harrison on keyboards and guitar. Emerging from New York's punk and new-wave scene, the band became known for combining rock with elements of funk, punk, art rock, and world music. Their intelligent, unusual lyrics and distinctive rhythms helped them stand apart from many other bands of the era. Some of their best-known songs include 'Psycho Killer', 'Once in a Lifetime', 'Burning Down the House' and 'Road to Nowhere'. Albums such as Fear of Music, Remain in Light, and Speaking in Tongues received widespread acclaim, while their 1984 concert film Stop Making Sense became especially celebrated. The band stopped performing together in the early 1990s, with the members pursuing other musical projects. Speaking in Tongues have been one of the world's finest groups celebrating the music of Talking Heads for over 20+ years. We are thrilled to welcome them back to London for their first concert in years. An AGMP Concerts presentation. This event is for over 18s only - No refunds will be issued for under 18s

His chart-topping podcast, On Purpose with Jay Shetty, has surpassed 1 billion listens and featured guests including Oprah Winfrey, Michelle Obama, Madonna, Selena Gomez, Will Smith, Kim Kardashian, Tom Holland and Lewis Hamilton, alongside leading experts and thought leaders. Jay is the bestselling author of Think Like a Monk and 8 Rules of Love, which inspired his first global live tour, Jay Shetty: Love Rules. AGMP Presents AGMP Concerts proudly presents FRED WESLEY & THE NEW J.B.'S Fred Wesley and The J.B.'s were one of the most influential funk bands of the 1970s, helping define the revolutionary sound of James Brown and laying the foundations for funk, disco, hip-hop and modern dance music. Led by legendary trombonist, arranger and bandleader Fred Wesley, The J.B.'s featured an extraordinary collection of musicians, including Maceo Parker, Jimmy Nolen, Clyde Stubblefield and John 'Jabo' Starks. Their explosive horn arrangements, infectious basslines and tightly interlocking rhythms created some of the greatest grooves in soul and funk history. Alongside their work with James Brown, the band released a string of classic recordings, including Pass the Peas, Gimme Some More, Doing It to Death, Damn Right I Am Somebody, Breakin' Bread and Blow Your Head. Their 1973 hit Doing It to Death reached #1 on the American R&B chart and remains a definitive funk anthem. Fred Wesley later joined George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic collective, further cementing his reputation as one of funk's greatest musical innovators. The J.B.'s recordings became essential to rare groove, acid jazz and funk scenes, while their unmistakable rhythms and horn breaks were sampled extensively by hip-hop pioneers including Public Enemy, Eric B. & Rakim and De La Soul amongst many others. Fred Wesley & The New J.B.'s are back to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the leegendary 'A Blow For Me, A Toot To You'…

Dutch-Sudanese singer-songwriter Gaidaa calls on a kaleidoscope of influences. Showing finesse and confidence beyond her years, she delicately weaves between neo-soul, RnB and jazz without fitting the mould of any one genre. With a voice that balances strength and softness, her music explores identity, vulnerability and growth through rich, emotionally charged storytelling. Since breaking through with A Storm on a Summer’s Day, Gaidaa has continued to carve out a space entirely her own — understated, soulful and impossible to put in a box. AGMP Presents AGMP Concerts present: VICTOR WOOTEN & THE WOOTEN BROTHERS Victor Wooten is a five-time Grammy Award-winning bassist, composer and producer, renowned for expanding the possibilities of the electric bass. He is best known as a founding member of Béla Fleck and the Flecktones, with whom he has performed and recorded for more than three decades, while his remarkable career has also seen him work with artists including Chick Corea, Stanley Clarke, Dave Matthews, Bootsy Collins, Branford Marsalis, Mike Stern, India.Arie and Keb' Mo'. A celebrated solo artist and influential educator as well as a virtuoso performer, Wooten is widely regarded as one of the most important and innovative bassists of his generation. Victor is joined by his brothers Joseph Wooten on keyboards, Roy "Future Man" Wooten on percussion, Regi Wooten on guitar and Rudy Wooten on saxophone. The brothers began performing together as children, developing an extraordinary musical connection that crosses funk, jazz, soul, R&B, rock and fusion, with each member bringing his own distinctive personality and virtuosity to the music. On stage, The Wooten Brothers are about far more than technical brilliance. Their performances combine dazzling musicianship, improvisation, deep grooves and a genuine sense of fun, underpinned by the instinctive chemistry that comes from a lifetime of playing together. events.description: FASHION THRIFT SOCIETY IS COMING TO LONDON London, Fashion Thrift Society is taking over Copeland Park on Saturday 22nd of May from 11AM–5PM. Australia’s biggest curated fashion market brings together vintage, preloved and independent fashion, local creatives, food, music, beauty, experiences and more - all under one roof. WHAT’S ON 50+ curated stalls featuring vintage, preloved, designer and independent brands Thousands of unique pieces to shop Second-hand treasures alongside products from independent small businesses Local food vendors Music and DJs at select events Beauty, fashion and creative activations that vary from city to city SHOPPING AT FTS Every stall at Fashion Thrift Society is run by an individual business or independent stallholder. Purchases are made and paid for directly at each stall, with no central FTS checkout. Most stallholders accept card and/or cash, however payment methods vary between vendors, so we recommend having both available. Bring along a reusable shopping bag or tote to carry your finds throughout the day. FTS tote bags will also be available to purchase at the merch desk at selected events. BEAUTY, SERVICES & ACTIVATIONS Alongside shopping, FTS events feature a rotating line-up of free and paid beauty, fashion and creative experiences. Depending on the city, these may include nails, hair styling, barbering, tattoos, henna, permanent jewellery, piercings, tooth gems, grillz, tarot, brows and lashes, colour analysis, fashion illustration…

events.description: Don McLean, the writer of 'American Pie' and 'Vincent' and one of the last working links to the Greenwich Village folk scene of the 1960s, is closing his 'Farewell Tour' at the Royal Albert Hall, 55 years on from debuting at the famous venue in 1972.

AGMP Presents XTC's legendary drummer, Terry Chambers, is back on the road with his band EXTC (named and approved by XTC frontman, Andy Partridge). Emerging out of the post-punk and new-wave explosion of the late 70s, XTC experienced global success touring with the likes of The Police and Talking Heads. Sadly, their legions of loyal fans would be left in limbo when in 1982 XTC stopped touring, becoming a studio-based entity. EXTC were formed in 2019 by XTC's drummer Terry Chambers, performing classic XTC material such as Making Plans For Nigel, Senses Working Overtime, Mayor of Simpleton, Generals and Majors, Sgt. Rock (Is Going To Help Me), Love on a Farmboy's Wages and many more. An AGMP Concerts presentation.

events.description: AGMP Concerts presents FLUNK 'For Sleepyheads Only' 25th Anniversary Concert + special guests Worldwide exclusive concert where Flunk will perform the entire downbeat classic 'For Sleepyheads Only' LP in full. Flunk are a Norwegian trip-hop and electronic indie pop band formed in Oslo in 2000-2001 by producer and programmer Ulf Nygaard and guitarist Jo Bakke, later joined by vocalist Anja Øyen Vister. Blending atmospheric electronica, downtempo beats, dreamy acoustic guitars and delicate, ethereal vocals, the group developed a distinctive sound influenced by trip-hop, dream pop, folk and ambient music. Signed to Norway's independent Beatservice Records, Flunk attracted international attention with their debut album For Sleepyheads Only (2002), particularly their beautifully understated reinterpretation of New Order's Blue Monday, which became an underground favourite and introduced the band to audiences worldwide. Their second album, Morning Star (2004), further established their reputation for sophisticated, atmospheric songwriting, featuring the acclaimed singles On My Balcony and Play, the latter gaining wider exposure through the American television series The O.C.. Subsequent releases included Play America (2005), Personal Stereo (2007), This Is What You Get (2009) and Lost Causes (2013), alongside several remix collections. Their music combined hypnotic electronic rhythms with shimmering guitars and Vister's haunting vocals, drawing comparisons with Massive Attack…

Not for him, but for his 2-year-old son who lives there. But how does 2026 compare to the one he grew up in? Tom explores the head f**k of popular culture in the modern world versus that of his youth in his trademark bittersweet style.
